DependencyOnArtifact.description: Dependency on the existence of another artifact, e.g. a library.

elements.name: artifactDescriptor
elements.description: The specified artifact needs to exist.

elements.name: usages
elements.description: Specification for which process step(s) this dependency is required.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

Describable.name: Describable
Describable.description: This meta-class represents the ability to add a descriptive documentation to non identifiable elements.

elements.name: desc
elements.description:
This represents a general but brief (one paragraph) description what the object in question is about. It is only one paragraph! Desc is intended to be collected into overview tables. This property helps a human reader to identify the object in question.

More elaborate documentation, (in particlar how the object is built or used) should go to "introduction".

elements.name: category
elements.description: The category is a keyword that specializes the semantics of the Describable. It affects the expected existence of attributes and the applicability of constraints.

elements.name: introduction
elements.description: This represents more information about how the object in question is built or is used. Therefore it is a DocumentationBlock.

elements.name: adminData
elements.description: This represents the administrative data for the describable object.

DhcpServerConfiguration.name: DhcpServerConfiguration
DhcpServerConfiguration.description: Defines the configuration of DHCP servers that are running on the network endpoint. It is possible that an Ipv4DhcpServer and an Ipv6DhcpServer run on the same Ecu.

elements.name: ipv4DhcpServerConfiguration
elements.description: Configuration of a IPv4 DHCP server that runs on the network endpoint.

elements.name: ipv6DhcpServerConfiguration
elements.description: Configuration of a IPv6 DHCP server that runs on the network endpoint.

DiagEventDebounceAlgorithm.name: DiagEventDebounceAlgorithm
DiagEventDebounceAlgorithm.description:
This class represents the ability to specify the pre-debounce algorithm which is selected and/or required by the particular monitor.

This class inherits from Identifiable in order to allow further documentation of the expected or implemented debouncing and to use the category for the identification of the expected / implemented debouncing.

DiagEventDebounceCounterBased.name: DiagEventDebounceCounterBased
DiagEventDebounceCounterBased.description:
This meta-class represents the ability to indicate that the counter-based debounce algorithm shall be used by the DEM for this diagnostic monitor.

This is related to set the ECUC choice container DemDebounceAlgorithmClass to DemDebounceCounterBased.

elements.name: counterDecrementStepSize
elements.description: This value shall be taken to decrement the internal debounce counter.

elements.name: counterFailedThreshold
elements.description: This value defines the event-specific limit that indicates the "failed" counter status.

elements.name: counterIncrementStepSize
elements.description: This value shall be taken to increment the internal debounce counter.

elements.name: counterJumpDown
elements.description: This value activates or deactivates the counter jump-down behavior.

elements.name: counterJumpDownValue
elements.description: This value represents the initial value of the internal debounce counter if the counting direction changes from incrementing to decrementing.

elements.name: counterJumpUp
elements.description: This value activates or deactivates the counter jump-up behavior.

elements.name: counterJumpUpValue
elements.description: This value represents the initial value of the internal debounce counter if the counting direction changes from decrementing to incrementing.

elements.name: counterPassedThreshold
elements.description: This value defines the event-specific limit that indicates the "passed" counter status.

DiagEventDebounceMonitorInternal.name: DiagEventDebounceMonitorInternal
DiagEventDebounceMonitorInternal.description:
This meta-class represents the ability to indicate that the pre-debounce algorithm shall be used by the DEM for this diagnostic monitor.

This is related to setting the ECUC choice container DemDebounceAlgorithmClass to DemDebounceMonitorInternal.

If the FaultDetectionAlogrithm is already known to be implemented by a specific BswModuleEntry the reference bswModuleEntry points to the function specification.

If the FaultDetectionCounter value is accessible at a PortPrototype this PortPrototype shall be referenced by an assignedPort.

DiagEventDebounceTimeBased.name: DiagEventDebounceTimeBased
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased.description:
This meta-class represents the ability to indicate that the time-based pre-debounce algorithm shall be used by the DEM for this diagnostic monitor.

This is related to set the ECUC choice container DemDebounceAlgorithmClass to DemDebounceTimeBase.

elements.name: timeFailedThreshold
elements.description: This value represents the event-specific delay indicating the "failed" status.

elements.name: timePassedThreshold
elements.description: This value represents the event-specific delay indicating the "passed" status.

DiagnosticAbstractDataIdentifier.name: DiagnosticAbstractDataIdentifier
DiagnosticAbstractDataIdentifier.description: This meta-class represents an abstract base class for the modeling of a diagnostic data identifier (DID).

elements.name: id
elements.description: This is the numerical identifier used to identify the DiagnosticAbstractDataIdentifier in the scope of diagnostic workflow

DiagnosticAccessPermission.name: DiagnosticAccessPermission
DiagnosticAccessPermission.description:
This represents the specification of whether a given service can be accessed according to the existence of meta-classes referenced by a particular DiagnosticAccessPermission.

In other words, this meta-class acts as a mapping element between several (otherwise unrelated) pieces of information that are put into context for the purpose of checking for access rights.

elements.name: diagnosticSessionRefs
elements.description: This represents the associated DiagnosticSessions

elements.name: securityLevelRefs
elements.description: This represents the associated DiagnosticSecurityLevels

elements.name: agingCycles
elements.description:
This represents the applicable aging cycle.
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

elements.name: threshold
elements.description: Number of aging cycles needed to unlearn/delete the event.

DiagnosticCapabilityElement.name: DiagnosticCapabilityElement
DiagnosticCapabilityElement.description: This class identifies the capability to provide generic information about diagnostic capabilities

elements.name: audiences
elements.description: This specifies the intended audience for the diagnostic object. Note that this is not only for the documentation but also subsequent audience specific implementation.

elements.name: diagRequirement
elements.description:
This denotes the requirement identifier to which the object can be linked to.

Note that with the implementation of a generic tracing concept in AUTOSAR this attribute might become obsolete.

elements.name: securityAccessLevel
elements.description:
This attribute denotes the level of security which is touched by the diagnostic object. The higher the level the more relevance for the security exists.

This level shall be mapped to the security level in the ECU.

DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformation.name: DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformation
DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformation.description: This represents an instance of the "Clear Diagnostic Information" diagnostic service.

elements.name: clearDiagnosticInformationClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformation in the given context.

DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformationClas.name: DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformationClass
DiagnosticClearDiagnosticInformationClas.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Clear Diagnostic Information" diagnostic service.

DiagnosticComControl.name: DiagnosticComControl
DiagnosticComControl.description: This represents an instance of the "Communication Control" diagnostic service.

elements.name: comControlClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticComControl in the given context.

elements.name: customSubFunctionNumber
elements.description: This attribute shall be used to define a custom sub-function number if none of the standardized values of category shall be used.

DiagnosticComControlClass.name: DiagnosticComControlClass
DiagnosticComControlClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Communication Control" diagnostic service.

elements.name: allChannelsRefs
elements.description:
This reference represents the semantics that all available channels shall be affected. It is still necessary to refer to individual CommunicatuionClusters because there could be private CommunicationClusters in the System Extract that are not subject to the service "communication control".

By referring to the applicable CommunicationClusters it can be made sure that only the affected CommunicationClusters are accessed.

elements.name: specificChannels
elements.description: This represents the ability to add additional attributes to the case that only specific channels are supposed to be considered,

DiagnosticComControlSpecificChannel.name: DiagnosticComControlSpecificChannel
DiagnosticComControlSpecificChannel.description: This represents the ability to add further attributes to the definition of a specific channel that is subject to the diagnostic service "communication control".

elements.name: specificChannelRef
elements.description: This represents the affected CommunicationClusters in the role specificChannel

elements.name: subnetNumber
elements.description: This represents the applicable subnet number (which is an arbitrary number ranging from 1..14)

DiagnosticComControlSubNodeChannel.name: DiagnosticComControlSubNodeChannel
DiagnosticComControlSubNodeChannel.description: This represents the ability to add further attributes to the definition of a specific sub-node channel that is subject to the diagnostic service "communication control".

elements.name: subNodeChannelRef
elements.description: This represents the affected CommunicationClusters in the role subNodeChannel

elements.name: subNodeNumber
elements.description: This represents the applicable subNode number. The value corresponds to the request message parameter nodeIdentificationNumber of diagnostic service CommunicationControl (0x28).

DiagnosticCommonElement.name: DiagnosticCommonElement
DiagnosticCommonElement.description: This meta-class represents a common base class for all diagnostic elements. It does not contribute any specific functionality other than the ability to become the target of a reference.

DiagnosticCommonElementRefConditional.name: DiagnosticCommonElementRefConditional
DiagnosticCommonElementRefConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticCommonProps.name: DiagnosticCommonProps
DiagnosticCommonProps.description: This meta-class aggregates a number of common properties that are shared among a diagnostic extract.

elements.name: diagnosticCommonPropsVariants
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticCommonPropsConditional.name: DiagnosticCommonPropsConditional
DiagnosticCommonPropsConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticCommonPropsContent.name: DiagnosticCommonPropsContent
DiagnosticCommonPropsContent.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: agingRequiresTestedCycle
elements.description:
Defines whether the aging cycle counter is processed every aging cycles or else only tested aging cycle are considered.

If the attribute is set to TRUE: only tested aging cycle are considered for aging cycle counter.

If the attribute is set to FALSE: aging cycle counter is processed every aging cycle.

elements.name: clearDtcLimitation
elements.description: Defines the scope of the DEM_ClearDTC Api.

elements.name: debounceAlgorithmPropss
elements.description:
Defines the used debounce algorithms relevant in
the context of the enclosing
DiagnosticCommonProps. Usually, there is a
variety of debouncing algorithms to take into
account and therefore the multiplicity of this
aggregation is set to 0..*.

elements.name: defaultEndianness
elements.description: Defines the default endianness of the data belonging to a DID or RID which is applicable if the DiagnosticDataElement does not define the endianness via the swDataDefProps.baseType attribute.

elements.name: dtcStatusAvailabilityMask
elements.description: Mask for the supported DTC status bits by the Dem.

elements.name: environmentDataCapture
elements.description: This attribute determines whether the capturing of environment data is done synchronously inside the report API function or whether the capturing shall be done asynchronously, i.e. after the report API function already terminated.

elements.name: eventDisplacementStrategy
elements.description: This attribute defines, whether support for event displacement is enabled or not, and which displacement strategy is followed.

elements.name: maxNumberOfEventEntries
elements.description: This attribute fixes the maximum number of event entries in the fault memory.

elements.name: maxNumberOfRequestCorrectlyReceivedResponsePending
elements.description:
Maximum number of negative responses with response code 0x78 (requestCorrectlyReceived-ResponsePending) allowed per request. DCM will send a negative response with response code 0x10 (generalReject), in case the limit value gets reached.
Value 0xFF means that no limit number of NRC 0x78 response apply.

elements.name: memoryEntryStorageTrigger
elements.description: Describes the primary trigger to allocate an event memory entry.

elements.name: occurrenceCounterProcessing
elements.description: This attribute defines the consideration of the fault confirmation process for the occurrence counter.

elements.name: resetConfirmedBitOnOverflow
elements.description: This attribute defines, whether the confirmed bit is reset or not while an event memory entry will be displaced.

elements.name: responseOnAllRequestSids
elements.description: If set to FALSE the DCM will not respond to diagnostic request that contains a service ID which is in the range from 0x40 to 0x7F or in the  range from 0xC0 to 0xFF (Response IDs).

elements.name: responseOnSecondDeclinedRequest
elements.description:
Defines the reaction upon a second request (ClientB) that can not be processed (e.g. due to priority assessment).

TRUE: when the second request (Client B) can not be processed, it shall be answered with NRC21 BusyRepeatRequest.

FALSE: when the second request (Client B) can not be processed, it shall not be responded.

elements.name: securityDelayTimeOnBoot
elements.description:
Start delay timer on power on in seconds. 

This delay indicates the time at ECU boot power-on time where the Dcm remains in the default session and does not accept a security access.

elements.name: statusBitHandlingTestFailedSinceLastClear
elements.description: This attribute defines, whether the aging and displacement mechanism shall be applied to the "TestFailedSinceLastClear" status bits.

elements.name: statusBitStorageTestFailed
elements.description:
This parameter is used to activate/deactivate the permanent storage of the "TestFailed" status bits.
true: storage activated 
false: storage deactivated

elements.name: typeOfDtcSupported
elements.description: This attribute defines the format returned by Dem_DcmGetTranslationType and does not relate to/influence the supported Dem functionality.

elements.name: typeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration
elements.description: This attribute defines the type of assigning freeze frame record numbers for event-specific freeze frame records.

DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds.name: DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds
DiagnosticCommunicationManagerNeeds.description: Specifies the general needs on the configuration of the  Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) which are not related to a particular item (e.g. a PID or DiagnosticRoutineNeeds). The main use case is the mapping of service ports to the DCM which are not related to a particular item.

elements.name: serviceRequestCallbackType
elements.description: This represents the ability to define whether the usage of PortInterface ServiceRequestNotification has the characteristics of being initiated by a manufacturer or by a supplier.

DiagnosticCondition.name: DiagnosticCondition
DiagnosticCondition.description: Abstract element for StorageConditions and EnableConditions.

elements.name: initValue
elements.description:
Defines the initial status for enable or disable of acceptance/storage of event reports of a diagnostic event. The value is the initialization after power up (before this condition is reported the first time). 

true: acceptance/storage of a diagnostic event enabled
false: acceptance/storage of a diagnostic event disabled

DiagnosticConditionGroup.name: DiagnosticConditionGroup
DiagnosticConditionGroup.description: Abstract element for StorageConditionGroups and EnableConditionGroups.

DiagnosticConnectedIndicator.name: DiagnosticConnectedIndicator
DiagnosticConnectedIndicator.description: Description of indicators that are defined per DiagnosticEvent.

elements.name: behavior
elements.description: Behavior of the linked indicator.

elements.name: healingCycleRef
elements.description: The deactivation of indicators per event is defined as healing of a diagnostic event. The operation cycle in which the warning indicator will be switched off is defined here.

elements.name: indicatorRef
elements.description: Reference to the used indicator.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticConnection.name: DiagnosticConnection
DiagnosticConnection.description: DiagnosticConncection that is used to describe the relationship between several TP connections.

elements.name: functionalRequestRefs
elements.description: Reference to functional request messages.

elements.name: periodicResponseUudtRefs
elements.description: Reference to UUDT responses.

elements.name: physicalRequestRef
elements.description: Reference to a physical request message.

elements.name: responseOnEventRef
elements.description: Reference to a ROE message.

elements.name: responseRef
elements.description: In the vast majority of cases a response is required. However, there are also cases where providing the response is not possible and/or not allowed.

DiagnosticConnectionRefConditional.name: DiagnosticConnectionRefConditional
DiagnosticConnectionRefConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: ecuInstanceRefs
elements.description: This represents the collection of EcuInstances that are affected by the DiagnosticContributionSet.

elements.name: elements
elements.description:
This represents a DiagnosticCommonElement considered in the context of the DiagnosticContributionSet
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

elements.name: serviceTables
elements.description:
This represents the collection of DiagnosticServiceTables to be considered in the scope of this DiagnosticContributionSet.
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

DiagnosticControlDTCSetting.name: DiagnosticControlDTCSetting
DiagnosticControlDTCSetting.description: This represents an instance of the "Control DTC Setting" diagnostic service.

elements.name: dtcSettingClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticControlDTCSetting in the given context.

elements.name: dtcSettingParameter
elements.description: This represents the DTCSettingType defined by ISO 14229-1. The pre-defined values are 1 (ON) and 2 (OFF).

DiagnosticControlDTCSettingClass.name: DiagnosticControlDTCSettingClass
DiagnosticControlDTCSettingClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Control DTC Setting" diagnostic service.

elements.name: controlOptionRecordPresent
elements.description: This represents the decision whether the DTCSettingControlOptionRecord (see ISO 14229-1) is in general supported in the request message.

DiagnosticCustomServiceClass.name: DiagnosticCustomServiceClass
DiagnosticCustomServiceClass.description: This represents the ability to define a custom diagnostic service class and assign an ID to it. Further configuration is not foreseen from the point of view of the diagnostic extract and consequently needs to be done on the level of ECUC.

elements.name: customServiceId
elements.description: This attribute may only be used for the definition of custom services. The values shall not overlap with existing standardized service IDs.

DiagnosticDataByIdentifier.name: DiagnosticDataByIdentifier
DiagnosticDataByIdentifier.description: This represents an abstract base class for all diagnostic services that access data by identifier.

elements.name: dataIdentifierRef
elements.description: This represents the linked DiagnosticDataIdentifier.

DiagnosticDataChangeTrigger.name: DiagnosticDataChangeTrigger
DiagnosticDataChangeTrigger.description: This represents the ability to define a trigger based on the change of a given DiagnosticDataIdentifier.

elements.name: dataIdentifierRef
elements.description: This represents the corresponding DiagnosticDataIdentifier.

DiagnosticDataElement.name: DiagnosticDataElement
DiagnosticDataElement.description: This meta-class represents the ability to describe a concrete piece of data to be taken into account for diagnostic purposes.

elements.name: arraySizeSemantics
elements.description: This attribute controls the meaning of the value of the array size.

elements.name: maxNumberOfElements
elements.description: The existence of this attribute turns the data instance into an array of data. The attribute determines the size of the array in terms of how many elements the array can take.

elements.name: swDataDefProps
elements.description: This property allows to specify data definition properties in order to support the definition of e.g. computation formulae and data constraints.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticDataIdentifier.name: DiagnosticDataIdentifier
DiagnosticDataIdentifier.description: This meta-class represents the ability to model a diagnostic data identifier (DID) that is fully specified regarding the payload at configuration-time.

elements.name: dataElements
elements.description:
This is the dataElement associated with the DiagnosticDataIdentifier.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: representsVin
elements.description: This attributes indicates whether the specific DiagnosticDataIdentifier represents the vehicle identification.

DiagnosticDataIdentifierSet.name: DiagnosticDataIdentifierSet
DiagnosticDataIdentifierSet.description: This represents the ability to define a list of DiagnosticDataIdentifiers that can be reused in different contexts.

elements.name: dataIdentifierRefs
elements.description: Reference to an orderd list of Data Identifiers.

DiagnosticDataTransfer.name: DiagnosticDataTransfer
DiagnosticDataTransfer.description: This represents an instance of the "Data Transfer" diagnostic service.

elements.name: dataTransferClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticDataTransfer in the given context.

DiagnosticDataTransferClass.name: DiagnosticDataTransferClass
DiagnosticDataTransferClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Data Transfer" diagnostic service.

DiagnosticDebounceAlgorithmProps.name: DiagnosticDebounceAlgorithmProps
DiagnosticDebounceAlgorithmProps.description: Defines properties for the debounce algorithm class.

elements.name: debounceAlgorithm
elements.description: This represents the actual debounce algorithm.

elements.name: debounceBehavior
elements.description: This attribute defines how the event debounce algorithm will behave, if a related enable condition is not fulfilled or ControlDTCSetting of the related event is disabled.

elements.name: debounceCounterStorage
elements.description:
Switch to store the debounce counter value non-volatile or not.
true: debounce counter value shall be stored non-volatile 
false: debounce counter value is volatile

DiagnosticDemProvidedDataMapping.name: DiagnosticDemProvidedDataMapping
DiagnosticDemProvidedDataMapping.description: This represents the ability to define the nature of a data access for a DiagnsoticDataElement in the Dem.

elements.name: dataElementRef
elements.description: This represents the DiagnosticDataElement for which the access is further qualified by the DiagnosticDemProvidedDataMapping.

elements.name: dataProvider
elements.description: This represents the ability to further specify the access within the Dem.

DiagnosticDtcChangeTrigger.name: DiagnosticDtcChangeTrigger
DiagnosticDtcChangeTrigger.description: This represents the ability to define a trigger that executes on the change of any DiagnosticTroubleCode.

DiagnosticDynamicDataIdentifier.name: DiagnosticDynamicDataIdentifier
DiagnosticDynamicDataIdentifier.description: This meta-class represents the ability to define a diagnostic data identifier (DID) at run-time.

DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifie.name: DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifie.description: This represents an instance of the "Dynamically Define Data Identifier" diagnostic service.

elements.name: dataIdentifierRef
elements.description: This represents the applicable DiagnosticDynamicDataIdentfier.

elements.name: dynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier in the given context.

elements.name: maxSourceElement
elements.description: This represents the maximum number of source elements of the dynamically created DID.

DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifie.name: DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifie.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Dynamically Define Data Identifier" diagnostic service.

elements.name: checkPerSourceId
elements.description:
If set to TRUE, the Dcm module shall check the session, security and mode dependencies per source DIDs with a ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF.

If set to FALSE. the Dcm module shall not check the session, security and mode dependencies per source DIDs with a ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF.

elements.name: configurationHandling
elements.description: This configuration switch defines whether DDDID definition is handled as non-volatile information or not.

DiagnosticEcuProps.name: DiagnosticEcuProps
DiagnosticEcuProps.description: This meta-class is defined to gather diagnostic-related properties that apply in the scope of an entire ECU.

elements.name: isObdRelevant
elements.description: This attribute indicates whether the ECU makes any contribution to the OBD.

elements.name: sendRespPendOnTransToBoot
elements.description: The purpose of this attribute is to define whether or not the ECU should send a NRC 0x78 (response pending) before transitioning to the bootloader (in this case the attribute shall be set to "true") or if the transition shall be initiated without sending NRC 0x78 (in this case the attribute shall be set to "false").

DiagnosticEcuReset.name: DiagnosticEcuReset
DiagnosticEcuReset.description: This represents an instance of the "ECU Reset" diagnostic service.

elements.name: customSubFunctionNumber
elements.description: This attribute shall be used to define a custom sub-function number if none of the standardized values of category shall be used.

elements.name: ecuResetClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticEcuReset in the given context.

elements.name: respondToReset
elements.description: This attribute defines whether the response to the EcuReset service shall be transmitted before or after the actual reset.

DiagnosticEcuResetClass.name: DiagnosticEcuResetClass
DiagnosticEcuResetClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Ecu Reset" diagnostic service.

DiagnosticEnableConditionGroup.name: DiagnosticEnableConditionGroup
DiagnosticEnableConditionGroup.description: Enable condition group which includes one or several enable conditions.

elements.name: enableConditions
elements.description:
Reference to enableConditions that are part of the EnableConditionGroup.
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

DiagnosticEnableConditionNeeds.name: DiagnosticEnableConditionNeeds
DiagnosticEnableConditionNeeds.description: This meta-class represents the needs of a software-component to provide the capability to set an enable condition.

elements.name: initialStatus
elements.description: Defines the initial status for enable or disable of acceptance of event reports of a diagnostic event.

DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping.name: DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping
DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping.description: Defines to which SWC service ports with DiagnosticEnableConditionNeeds the DiagnosticEnableCondition is mapped.

elements.name: enableConditionRef
elements.description: Reference to the EnableCondition which is mapped to a SWC service port with DiagnosticEnableConditionNeeds.

elements.name: swcFlatServiceDependencyRef
elements.description: Reference to a SwcServiceDependencyType that links ServiceNeeds to SWC service ports.

elements.name: swcServiceDependencyIref
elements.description: Instance reference to a SwcServiceDependency that links ServiceNeeds to SWC service ports.

DiagnosticEnableConditionRefConditional.name: DiagnosticEnableConditionRefConditional
DiagnosticEnableConditionRefConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticEvent.name: DiagnosticEvent
DiagnosticEvent.description: This element is used to configure DiagnosticEvents.

elements.name: agingAllowed
elements.description: This represents the decision whether aging is allowed for this DiagnosticEvent.

elements.name: clearEventBehavior
elements.description: This attribute defines the resulting UDS status byte for the related event, which shall not be cleared according to the ClearEventAllowed callback.

elements.name: connectedIndicators
elements.description:
Event specific description of Indicators.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: eventClearAllowed
elements.description: This attribute defines whether the Dem has access to a "ClearEventAllowed" callback.

elements.name: eventFailureCycleCounterThreshold
elements.description: This attribute defines the number of failure cycles for the event based fault confirmation.

elements.name: eventKind
elements.description: This attribute is used to distinguish between SWC and BSW events.

elements.name: prestorageFreezeFrame
elements.description:
This attribute describes whether the Prestorage of FreezeFrames is supported by the assigned event or not.

True: Prestorage of FreezeFrames is supported
False:  Prestorage of FreezeFrames is not supported

DiagnosticEventInfoNeeds.name: DiagnosticEventInfoNeeds
DiagnosticEventInfoNeeds.description: This meta-class represents the needs of a software-component interested to get information regarding specific DTCs.

elements.name: dtcKind
elements.description:
This attribute indicates the kind of the diagnostic event according to the SWS Diagnostic Event Manger for which the DiagnosticInfo is requested.

This attribute applies for the UDS diagnostics use case.

elements.name: dtcNumber
elements.description: This represents a reasonable Diagnostic Trouble Code for which the DiagnosticInfo is requested.

elements.name: obdDtcNumber
elements.description:
This represents a reasonable Diagnostic Trouble Code.

This allows to predefine the Diagnostic Trouble Code, e.g. if the function developer has received a particular requirement from the OEM or from a standardization body.

This attribute applies for the OBD diagnostics use case.

elements.name: udsDtcNumber
elements.description:
This represents a reasonable Diagnostic Trouble Code.

This allows to predefine the Diagnostic Trouble Code, e.g. if the function developer has received a particular requirement from the OEM or from a standardization body.

This attribute applies for the UDS diagnostics use case.

DiagnosticEventManagerNeeds.name: DiagnosticEventManagerNeeds
DiagnosticEventManagerNeeds.description: Specifies the general needs on the configuration of the  Diagnostic Event Manager (DEM) which are not related to a particular item.

DiagnosticEventNeeds.name: DiagnosticEventNeeds
DiagnosticEventNeeds.description:
Specifies the abstract needs on the configuration of the Diagnostic Event Manager for one diagnostic event. Its shortName can be regarded as a symbol identifying the diagnostic event from the viewpoint of the component or module which owns this element.

In case the diagnostic event specifies a production error, the shortName shall be the name of the production error.

elements.name: considerPtoStatus
elements.description: PTO (Power Take Off) has an impact on the respective emission-related event (OBD). This information shall be provided by SW-C description in order to consider the PTO relevance e.g. for readiness (PID $01) computation. For events with dtcKind set to 'nonEmmissionRelatedDtc' this attribute is typically false.

elements.name: deferringFidRefs
elements.description: This reference contains the link to a function identifier within the FiM which is used by the monitor before delivering a result.

elements.name: diagEventDebounceAlgorithm
elements.description: Specifies the abstract need on the Debounce Algorithm applied by the Diagnostic Event Manager.

elements.name: dtcKind
elements.description:
This attribute indicates the kind of the diagnostic monitor according to the SWS Diagnostic Event Manger. 

This attribute applies for the UDS diagnostics use case.

elements.name: dtcNumber
elements.description:
This represents a reasonable Diagnostic Trouble Code.

elements.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for J1939 (consiting of SPN and FMI).

DiagnosticTroubleCodeObd.name: DiagnosticTroubleCodeObd
DiagnosticTroubleCodeObd.description: This element is used to define OBD-relevant DTCs.

elements.name: considerPtoStatus
elements.description:
This attribute describes the affection of the event by the Dem PTO handling. 

True: the event is affected by the Dem PTO handling.
False: the event is not affected by the Dem PTO handling.

elements.name: eventObdReadinessGroup
elements.description: This attribute specifies the Event OBD Readiness group for PID $01 and PID $41 computation. This attribute is only applicable for emission-related ECUs.

elements.name: obdDtcValue
elements.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for OBD.

DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.name: DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.description: This element defines common Dtc properties that can be reused by different non OBD-relevant DTCs.

elements.name: agingRef
elements.description: Reference to an aging algorithm in case that an aging/unlearning of the event is allowed.

elements.name: environmentCaptureToReporting
elements.description: This attribute determines the point in time, when the data actually is captured.

elements.name: extendedDataRecords
elements.description:
Defines the links to an extended data class sampler.
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

elements.name: fdcThresholdStorageValue
elements.description: Threshold to allocate an event memory entry and to capture the Freeze Frame. Unit: none (attribute represents a counter value).

elements.name: freezeFrames
elements.description:
Define the links to a freeze frame class sampler.
This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

elements.name: freezeFrameContentRef
elements.description: This represents the content of the a set of DiagnosticFreezeFrames.

elements.name: immediateNvDataStorage
elements.description:
Switch to enable immediate storage triggering of an according event memory entry persistently to NVRAM.

true: immediate non-volatile storage triggering enabled 
false: immediate non-volatile storage triggering disabled

elements.name: maxNumberFreezeFrameRecords
elements.description: This attribute defines the number of according freeze frame records, which can maximal be stored for this event. Therefore all these freeze frame records have the same freeze frame class.

elements.name: memoryDestinationRefs
elements.description: The event destination assigns events to none, one or multiple origins.

elements.name: priority
elements.description: Priority of the event, in view of full event buffer. A lower value means higher priority.

elements.name: significance
elements.description: Significance of the event, which indicates additional information concerning fault classification and resolution.

DiagnosticTroubleCodeRefConditional.name: DiagnosticTroubleCodeRefConditional
DiagnosticTroubleCodeRefConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds.name: DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds
DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds.description: This element is used to describe non OBD-relevant DTCs.

elements.name: dtcPropsRef
elements.description: Defined properties associated with the DemDTC.

elements.name: functionalUnit
elements.description:
This attribute specifies a 1-byte value which identifies the corresponding basic vehicle / system function which reports the DTC. This parameter
is necessary for the report of severity information.

elements.name: severity
elements.description: DTC severity according to ISO 14229-1.

elements.name: udsDtcValue
elements.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for UDS.

DiagnosticValueNeeds.name: DiagnosticValueNeeds
DiagnosticValueNeeds.description:
Specifies the general needs on the configuration of the  Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) which are not related to a particular item (e.g. a PID). The main use case is the mapping of service ports to the DCM which are not related to a particular item.

In the case of using a sender receiver communicated value, the related value shall be taken via assignedData in the role "signalBasedDiagnostics".

In case of using a client/server communicated value, the related value shall be communicated via the port referenced by asssignedPort. The details of this communication (e.g. appropriate naming conventions) are specified in the related software specifications (SWS).

elements.name: dataLength
elements.description:
This attribute is applicable only if the ServiceNeed is aggregated within BswModuleDependency.

This attribute represents the length of data (in bytes) provided for this particular PID signal.

elements.name: diagnosticValueAccess
elements.description: This attribute controls whether the data can be read and written or whether it is to be handled read-only.

elements.name: didNumber
elements.description:
This represents a Data identifier for the diagnostic value.
This allows to predefine the DID number if the responsible function developer has received a particular requirement from the OEM or from a standardization body.

elements.name: fixedLength
elements.description: This attribute controls whether the data length of the data is fixed.

elements.name: processingStyle
elements.description: This attribute controls whether interaction requires the software-component to react synchronously on a request or whether it processes the request in background but still the DCM has to issue the call again to eventually obtain the result of the request.

DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifier.name: DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifier
DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifier.description: This represents an instance of the "Write Data by Identifier" diagnostic service.

elements.name: writeClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby,  the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifier in the given context.

DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifierClass.name: DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifierClass
DiagnosticWriteDataByIdentifierClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Write Data by Identifier" diagnostic service.

DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddress.name: DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddress
DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddress.description: This represents an instance of the "Write Memory by Address" diagnostic service.

elements.name: writeClassRef
elements.description:
This reference substantiates that abstract reference in the role serviceClass for this specific concrete class. 

Thereby, the reference represents the ability to access shared attributes among all DiagnosticWritememoryByAddress in the given context.

DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddressClass.name: DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddressClass
DiagnosticWriteMemoryByAddressClass.description: This meta-class contains attributes shared by all instances of the "Write Memory by Address" diagnostic service.

DiagnosticsCommunicationSecurityNeeds.name: DiagnosticsCommunicationSecurityNeeds
DiagnosticsCommunicationSecurityNeeds.description: This meta-class represents the needs of a software-component to verify the access to security level via diagnostic services.

DiscoveryTechnology.name: DiscoveryTechnology
DiscoveryTechnology.description:
This element is deprecated and will be removed in future. This information is replaced by the runtimePortConfiguration and runtimeIpAddressConfiguration attributes in the SocketConnection.

Old description:
Discovery technology information.

elements.name: name
elements.description: Discovery technology used.

elements.name: version
elements.description: Version of the used Discovery protocol.

DltUserNeeds.name: DltUserNeeds
DltUserNeeds.description: Specifies the needs on the configuration of the Diagnostic Log and Trace module for one SessionId. This class currently contains no attributes. An instance of this class is used to find out which ports of an SWC belong to this SessionId in order to group the request and response ports of the same SessionId. The actual SessionId value is stored in the PortDefinedArgumentValue of the respective port specification.

DoIpActivationLineNeeds.name: DoIpActivationLineNeeds
DoIpActivationLineNeeds.description: A DoIP entity needs to be informed when an external tester is attached or activated. The DoIpActivationServiceNeeds specifies the trigger for such an event. Examples would be a Pdu via a regular communication bus, a PWM signal, or an I/O. For details please refer to the ISO 13400.

DoIpEntity.name: DoIpEntity
DoIpEntity.description: ECU providing this infrastructure service is a DoIP-Entity.

elements.name: doIpEntityRole
elements.description: Identifies the role in terms of DoIP this network-node has.

DoIpGidNeeds.name: DoIpGidNeeds
DoIpGidNeeds.description: The DoIpGidNeeds indicates that the software-component owning this ServiceNeeds is providing the GID number either after a GID Synchronisation or by other means like e.g. flashed EEPROM parameter. This need can be used independent from DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds and is necessary if the GID can not be provided out of the DoIP configuration options.

DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds.name: DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds
DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds.description: The DoIpGidSynchronizationNeeds indicates that the software-component owning this ServiceNeeds is triggered by the DoIP entity to start a synchronization of the GID (Group Identification) on the DoIP service 0x0001, 0x0002, 0x0003 or before announcement via service 0x0004 according to ISO 13400-2:2012 if necessary. Note that this need is only relevant for DoIP synchronization masters.

elements.name: address
elements.description: The logical DoIP address.

DoIpPowerModeStatusNeeds.name: DoIpPowerModeStatusNeeds
DoIpPowerModeStatusNeeds.description: The DoIpPowerModeStatusNeeds indicates that the software-component owning this ServiceNeeds is providing the PowerModeStatus for the DoIP service 0x4003 according to ISO 13400-2:2012.

DoIpRoutingActivationAuthenticationNeeds.name: DoIpRoutingActivationAuthenticationNeeds
DoIpRoutingActivationAuthenticationNeeds.description: DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationNeeds indicates that the software-component owning this ServiceNeeds will have an authentication required for a DoIP routing activation service (0x0005) according to ISO 13400-2:2012.

elements.name: dataLengthRequest
elements.description: Describes the length in byte of the additional information for RA authentication that is needed by the software entity. If the software entity is a SWC the attribute does not need to exist as the information is available via the length of the uint8 Array type. Otherwise (i.e the  software entity is a Complex Driver) this attribute needs to be filled out if additional information is needed.

elements.name: dataLengthResponse
elements.description: Describes the length in byte of the additional information for RA authentication that is provided by the software entity. If the software entity is a SWC the attribute does not need to exist as the information is available via the length of the uint8 Array type. Otherwise (i.e the  software entity is a Complex Driver) this attribute needs to be filled in if additional information is provided.

elements.name: routingActivationType
elements.description: Describes the ISO 13400-2:2012 "routing activation request activation type" which is received via DoIP service 0x0005. 0x00 is DEFAULT, 0x01 is WWH-OBD. If neither of the specified values (0x00 or 0x01) is needed the token shall contain RA_ + hex value representation of the integer value shall be used (i.e: RA_0xE1).

DoIpRoutingActivationConfirmationNeeds.name: DoIpRoutingActivationConfirmationNeeds
DoIpRoutingActivationConfirmationNeeds.description: DoIpRoutingActivationConfirmationNeeds indicates that the software-component that owns this ServiceNeeds will have a confirmation required for a DoIP routing activation service (0x0005) according to ISO 13400-2:2012.

elements.name: dataLengthRequest
elements.description: Describes the length in byte of the additional information for RA confirmation that is needed by the software entity. If the software entity is a SWC the attribute does not need to exist as the information is available via the length of the uint8 Array type. Otherwise (i.e the  software entity is a Complex Driver) this attribute needs to be filled out if additional information is needed.

elements.name: dataLengthResponse
elements.description: Describes the length in byte of the additional information for RA confirmation that is provided by the software entity. If the software entity is a SWC the attribute does not need to exist as the information is available via the length of the uint8 Array type. Otherwise (i.e the  software entity is a Complex Driver) this attribute needs to be filled out if additional information is provided.

elements.name: routingActivationType
elements.description: Describes the ISO 13400-2:2012 "routing activation request activation type" which is received via DoIP service 0x0005. 0x00 is DEFAULT, 0x01 is WWH-OBD. If neither of the specified values (0x00 or 0x01) is needed the token shall contain RA_ + hex value representation of the integer value shall be used (i.e: RA_0xE1).

DoIpServiceNeeds.name: DoIpServiceNeeds
DoIpServiceNeeds.description: This represents an abstract base class for ServiceNeeds related to DoIP.

DoIpTpConfig.name: DoIpTpConfig
DoIpTpConfig.description: This element defines exactly one DoIp Configuration.

elements.name: doIpLogicAddresss
elements.description: Collection of logical DoIP Addresses.

elements.name: tpConnections
elements.description: Collection of unidirectional connections between a source address and a target address.

DoIpTpConnection.name: DoIpTpConnection
DoIpTpConnection.description: A connection identifies the sender and the receiver of this particular communication. The DoIp module routes a tpSdu through this connection.

elements.name: doIpSourceAddressRef
elements.description: Reference to the source Address.

elements.name: doIpTargetAddressRef
elements.description: Reference to the target address.

elements.name: tpSduRef
elements.description: This reference is used to describe the data exchange between DoIp and the PduR. Only PduTriggerings of DcmIPdus shall be referenced here.

DocRevision.name: DocRevision
DocRevision.description: This meta-class represents the ability to maintain information which relates to revision management of documents or objects.

elements.name: revisionLabel
elements.description: This attribute represents the version number of the object.

elements.name: revisionLabelP1
elements.description: This attribute represents the version number of the first predecessor  of the object.

elements.name: revisionLabelP2
elements.description:
This attribute represents the version number of the second predecessor of the object.

This attribute is used if the object is the result of a merge process in which two branches are merged in to one new revision.

elements.name: state
elements.description: The attribute state represents the current state of the current file according to the configuration management plan. It is a NameToken until possible states are  standardized.

elements.name: issuedBy
elements.description: This is the name of an individual or an organization who issued the current revision of the document or document fragment.

elements.name: date
elements.description: This specifies the date and time, when the object in question was released

elements.name: modifications
elements.description: This property represents one particular modification in comparison to its predecessor.

DocumentViewSelectable.name: DocumentViewSelectable
DocumentViewSelectable.description: This meta-class represents the ability to be dedicated to a particular audience or document view.

Documentation.name: Documentation
Documentation.description: This meta-class represents the ability to handle a so called standalone documentation. Standalone means, that such a documentation is not embedded in another ARElement or identifiable object.  The standalone documentation is an entity of its own which denotes its context by reference to other objects and instances.

elements.name: contexts
elements.description: This is the context of the particular documentation.

elements.name: documentationContent
elements.description: This is the content of the documentation related to the specified contexts.

DocumentationBlock.name: DocumentationBlock
DocumentationBlock.description: This class represents a documentation block. It is made of basic text structure elements which can be displayed in a table cell.

elements.name: p
elements.description:
This is one particular paragraph.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: verbatim
elements.description:
This represents one particular verbatim text.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: list
elements.description:
This represents numbered or unnumbered list. 
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: defList
elements.description:
This represents a definition list in the documentation block.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: labeledList
elements.description:
This represents a labeled list.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: formula
elements.description:
This is a formula in the definition block.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: figure
elements.description:
This represents a figure in the documentation block.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: note
elements.description:
This represents a note in the text flow.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: trace
elements.description:
This represents traceable text in the documentation block. This allows to specify requirements/constraints in any documentation block.

The kind of the trace is specified in the category.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: structuredReq
elements.description:
This aggregation supports structured requirements embedded in a documentation block.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

DocumentationContext.name: DocumentationContext
DocumentationContext.description: This class represents the ability to denote a context of a so called standalone  documentation. Note that this is an <<atpMixed>>. The contents needs to be considered as ordered.

elements.name: featureIref
elements.description: This refers to a particular  feature (instance in the M0 model) to which is the context of the documentation.

elements.name: identifiableRef
elements.description: This is an identifiable object which is part of the context of the documentation.

DtcStatusChangeNotificationNeeds.name: DtcStatusChangeNotificationNeeds
DtcStatusChangeNotificationNeeds.description: This meta-class represents the needs of a software-component interested to get information regarding any DTC status change.

elements.name: dtcFormatType
elements.description: This attribute specifies the DTC format.

DynamicPart.name: DynamicPart
DynamicPart.description:
Dynamic part of a multiplexed I-Pdu. 
Reserved space which is used to transport varying SignalIPdus at the same position, controlled by the corresponding selectorFieldCode.

elements.name: dynamicPartAlternatives
elements.description: Com IPdu alternatives that are transmitted  in the Dynamic Part of the MultiplexedIPdu.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

DynamicPartAlternative.name: DynamicPartAlternative
DynamicPartAlternative.description:
One of the Com IPdu alternatives that are transmitted in the Dynamic Part of the MultiplexedIPdu. The selectorFieldCode
specifies which Com IPdu is contained in the DynamicPart within a
certain transmission of a multiplexed PDU.

elements.name: iPduRef
elements.description: Reference to a Com IPdu which is routed to the IPduM module and is combined to a multiplexedPdu.

elements.name: initialDynamicPart
elements.description:
Dynamic part that shall be used to initialize this multiplexed IPdu.

Constraint: Only one "DynamicPartAlternative" in a "DynamicPart" shall
be the initialDynamicPart.

elements.name: selectorFieldCode
elements.description: The selector field is part of a multiplexed IPdu. It consists of contiguous bits. The value of the selector field selects the layout of the multiplexed part of the IPdu.

ECUMapping.name: ECUMapping
ECUMapping.description: ECUMapping allows to assign an ECU hardware type (defined in the ECU Resource Template) to an ECUInstance used in a physical topology.

elements.name: commControllerMappings
elements.description: The ECUMapping contains the mapping of all CommunicationControllers of the ECU.

elements.name: ecuInstanceRef
elements.description: Reference to the EcuInstance in the System Template

elements.name: ecuRef
elements.description: Reference to the Ecu description in the ECU Resource Template.

elements.name: hwPortMappings
elements.description: The ECUMapping contains the mapping of all HW Communication Ports of the ECU.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

EOCEventRef.name: EOCEventRef
EOCEventRef.description: This is used to define a reference to an RTE or BSW Event.

elements.name: bswModuleInstanceRef
elements.description: Specifies the BSW module instance the BSW event is related to.

elements.name: componentIref
elements.description: This association references the specific instance of the SW-C prototype.

elements.name: eventRef
elements.description: The AbstractEvent (event) whose execution order is restricted by the contraint.

elements.name: successorRefs
elements.description: The logical successor of an executable entity or a group of executable entities.

EOCExecutableEntityRef.name: EOCExecutableEntityRef
EOCExecutableEntityRef.description:
This is used to define a reference to an ExecutableEntity

If the ExecutionOrderConstraint is defined on VFB, System or ECU level, a reference to the SwComponentPrototype, via the ComponentInCompositionInstanceRef, the referenced ExecutableEntity belongs to, must be provided as context information.

elements.name: bswModuleInstanceRef
elements.description: Specifies the BSW module instance the BSW module entity belongs to.

elements.name: componentIref
elements.description: This association references the specific instance of the SW-C prototype.

elements.name: executableRef
elements.description: The ExecutableEntity whose execution order is restricted by the contraint.

elements.name: successorRefs
elements.description: The logical successor of an executable entity or a group of executable entities.

EOCExecutableEntityRefAbstract.name: EOCExecutableEntityRefAbstract
EOCExecutableEntityRefAbstract.description: This is the abstractions for Execution Order Constraint Executable Entity References (leaves) and Execution Order Constraint Executable Entity Reference Groups (composites).

elements.name: directSuccessorRefs
elements.description: The direct successor of an executable entity or a group of executable entities.

EOCExecutableEntityRefGroup.name: EOCExecutableEntityRefGroup
EOCExecutableEntityRefGroup.description: This is used to specify a group (composite) consisting of Execution Order Constraint Executable Entity References (leaves) and/or further Execution Order Constraint Executable Entity Reference Groups (composite).

elements.name: maxCycles
elements.description: In case of a Repetitive Execution Order Constraint this attribute specifies the number of cycles the Execution Order Constraint is considering.

elements.name: maxSlots
elements.description: In case of a Repetitive Execution Order Constraint this attribute specifies the number of slots every cycle of the Execution Order Constraint is consisting of.

elements.name: nestedElementRefs
elements.description: This association is used to establish hierarchies of EOCEER Groups and References.

elements.name: successorRefs
elements.description: The logical successor of an executable entity or a group of executable entities.

elements.name: triggeringEventRef
elements.description: In case of a Repetitive Execution Order Constraint this association references the timing description event triggering every cycle.

EcuAbstractionSwComponentType.name: EcuAbstractionSwComponentType
EcuAbstractionSwComponentType.description: The ECUAbstraction is a special AtomicSwComponentType that resides between a software-component that wants to access ECU periphery and the Microcontroller Abstraction. The EcuAbstractionSwComponentType introduces the possibility to link from the software representation to its hardware description provided by the ECU Resource Template.

elements.name: hardwareElementRefs
elements.description: Reference from the EcuAbstractionComponentType to the description of the used HwElements.

EcuInstance.name: EcuInstance
EcuInstance.description: ECUInstances are used to define the ECUs used in the topology. The type of the ECU is defined by a reference to an ECU specified with the ECU resource description.

elements.name: associatedComIPduGroupRefs
elements.description:
With this reference it is possible to identify which ISignalIPduGroups are applicable for which CommunicationConnector/ ECU. 

Only top level ISignalIPduGroups shall be referenced by an EcuInstance. If an ISignalIPduGroup contains other ISignalIPduGroups than these contained ISignalIPduGroups shall not be referenced by the EcuInstance. Contained ISignalIPduGroups are associated to an EcuInstance via the top level ISignalIPduGroup.

elements.name: associatedPdurIPduGroupRefs
elements.description: With this reference it is possible to identify which PduR IPdu Groups are applicable for which CommunicationConnector/ ECU.

elements.name: canTpAddressRefs
elements.description:
Please note that this reference is deprecated and will be removed in future.

A Tp Address can be assigned to an ECU without an existing TP Configuration. If TpNodes are described this reference shall not be used.

elements.name: clientIdRange
elements.description: Restriction of the Client Identifier for this Ecu to an allowed range of numerical values. The Client Identifier of the transaction handle is generated by the client RTE for inter-Ecu Client/Server communication.

elements.name: comConfigurationGwTimeBase
elements.description: The period between successive calls to Com_MainFunctionRouteSignals of the AUTOSAR COM module in seconds.

elements.name: comConfigurationRxTimeBase
elements.description: The period between successive calls to Com_MainFunctionRx of the AUTOSAR COM module in seconds.

elements.name: comConfigurationTxTimeBase
elements.description: The period between successive calls to Com_MainFunctionTx of the AUTOSAR COM module in seconds.

elements.name: comEnableMdtForCyclicTransmission
elements.description: Enables for the Com module of this EcuInstance the minimum delay time monitoring for cyclic and repeated transmissions (TransmissionModeTiming has cyclicTiming assigned or eventControlledTiming with numberOfRepetitions > 0).

elements.name: commControllers
elements.description: CommunicationControllers of the ECU.

elements.name: connectors
elements.description: All channels controlled by a single controller.

elements.name: diagnosticAddress
elements.description: An ECU specific ID for responses of diagnostic routines.

elements.name: diagnosticProps
elements.description: This represents the diagnostic-related properties of an entire ECU.

elements.name: partitions
elements.description: Optional definition of Partitions within an Ecu.

elements.name: pnResetTime
elements.description: Specifies the runtime of the reset timer in seconds. This reset time is valid for the reset of PN requests in the EIRA and in the ERA.

elements.name: pncPrepareSleepTimer
elements.description: Time in seconds the PNC state machine shall wait in PNC_PREPARE_SLEEP.

elements.name: sleepModeSupported
elements.description:
Specifies whether the ECU instance may be put to a "low power mode" 
* true: sleep mode is supported 
* false: sleep mode is not supported 

Note: This flag may only be set to "true" if the feature is supported by both hardware and basic software.

elements.name: tpAddressRefs
elements.description:
Please note that this reference is deprecated and will be removed in future.

A Tp Address can be assigned to an ECU without an existing TP Configuration. If TpNodes are described this reference shall not be used.

elements.name: wakeUpOverBusSupported
elements.description: Driver support for wakeup over Bus.

EcuPartition.name: EcuPartition
EcuPartition.description: Partitions are used as error containment regions. They permit the grouping of SWCs and resources and allow to describe recovery policies individually for each partition. Partitions can be terminated or restarted during run-time as a result of a detected error.

elements.name: execInUserMode
elements.description: A partition can execute either in CPU user mode (execInUserMode = TRUE) or supervisor mode (execInUserMode = FALSE). In user mode, the partition has a limited access to memory, to memory mapped hardware and to CPU. In user mode, the partition is mapped to a non-trusted OS-Application.

EcuResourceEstimation.name: EcuResourceEstimation
EcuResourceEstimation.description: Resource estimations for RTE and BSW of a single ECU instance.

elements.name: introduction
elements.description: This represents introductory documentation about the ecu resource estimation

elements.name: bswResourceEstimation
elements.description: Estimation for the resource consumption of the basic software.

elements.name: ecuInstanceRef
elements.description: Reference to the ECU this estimation is done for.

elements.name: rteResourceEstimation
elements.description: Estimation for the resource consumption of the run time environment.

elements.name: swCompToEcuMappingRefs
elements.description: References to  SwcToEcuMappings that have been taken into account for the resource estimations. This way it is possible to define dfferent EcuResourceEstimations with diifferent mappings, e.g. before and after mapping an additional SW component.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

EcuStateMgrUserNeeds.name: EcuStateMgrUserNeeds
EcuStateMgrUserNeeds.description: Specifies the abstract needs on the configuration of the ECU State  Manager for one "user". This class currently contains no attributes. Its name can be regarded as a symbol identifying the user  from the viewpoint of the component or module which owns this class.

EcuTiming.name: EcuTiming
EcuTiming.description:
A model element used to define timing descriptions and constraints within the scope of one ECU configuration.

TimingDescriptions aggregated by EcuTiming are allowed to use all events derived from the class TimingDescriptionEvent.

elements.name: ecuConfigurationRef
elements.description: This defines the scope of an EcuTiming. All corresponding timing descriptions and constraints must be defined within this scope.

EcucAbstractConfigurationClass.name: EcucAbstractConfigurationClass
EcucAbstractConfigurationClass.description: Specifies the ValueConfigurationClass of a parameter/reference or the MultiplicityConfigurationClass of a parameter/reference or a container for each ConfigurationVariant of the EcucModuleDef.

elements.name: configClass
elements.description: Specifies the ConfigurationClass for the given ConfigurationVariant.

elements.name: configVariant
elements.description: Specifies the ConfigurationVariant the ConfigurationClass is specified for.

EcucAbstractReferenceDef.name: EcucAbstractReferenceDef
EcucAbstractReferenceDef.description: Common class to gather the attributes for the definition of references.

EcucAbstractReferenceValue.name: EcucAbstractReferenceValue
EcucAbstractReferenceValue.description: Abstract class to be used as common parent for all reference values in the ECU Configuration Description.

elements.name: definitionRef
elements.description: Reference to the definition of this EcucAbstractReferenceValue subclasses in the ECU Configuration Parameter Definition.

elements.name: annotations
elements.description: Possibility to provide additional notes while defining a model element (e.g. the ECU Configuration Parameter Values). These are not intended as documentation but are mere design notes.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

EcucAbstractStringParamDef.name: EcucAbstractStringParamDef
EcucAbstractStringParamDef.description:
Abstract class that is used to collect the common properties for StringParamDefs, LinkerSymbolDef, FunctionNameDef and MultilineStringParamDefs. 

atpVariation: [RS_ECUC_0083]

EcucAbstractStringParamDefContent.name: EcucAbstractStringParamDefContent
EcucAbstractStringParamDefContent.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: defaultValue
elements.description: Default value of the string configuration parameter.

EcucModuleConfigurationValues.name: EcucModuleConfigurationValues
EcucModuleConfigurationValues.description:
Head of the configuration of one Module. A Module can be a BSW module as well as the RTE and ECU Infrastructure.

As part of the BSW module description, the EcucModuleConfigurationValues element has two different roles:

The recommendedConfiguration contains parameter values recommended by the BSW module vendor. 

The preconfiguredConfiguration contains values for those parameters which are fixed by the implementation and cannot be changed.

These two EcucModuleConfigurationValues are used when the base EcucModuleConfigurationValues (as part of the base ECU configuration) is created to fill parameters with initial values.

elements.name: definitionRef
elements.description: Reference to the definition of this EcucModuleConfigurationValues element. Typically, this is a vendor specific module configuration.

elements.name: ecucDefEdition
elements.description:
This is the version info of the ModuleDef ECUC Parameter definition to which this values conform to / are based on.

For the Definition of ModuleDef ECUC Parameters the AdminData shall be used to express the semantic changes. The compatibility rules between the definition and value revision labels is up to the module's vendor.

elements.name: implementationConfigVariant
elements.description: Specifies the kind of deliverable this EcucModuleConfigurationValues element provides. If this element is not used in a particular role (e.g. preconfiguredConfiguration or recommendedConfiguration) then the value must be one of VariantPreCompile, VariantLinkTime, VariantPostBuild.

elements.name: moduleDescriptionRef
elements.description: Referencing the BSW module description, which this EcucModuleConfigurationValues element is configuring. This is optional because the EcucModuleConfigurationValues element is also used to configure the ECU infrastructure (memory map) or Application SW-Cs. However in case the EcucModuleConfigurationValues are used to configure the module, the reference is mandatory in order to fetch module specific "common" published information.

Aggregates all containers that belong to this module configuration.

elements.description:
Specifies whether it shall be allowed on the value side to specify this parameter value as "AUTO".

If withAuto is "true" it shall be possible to set the "isAutoValue" attribute of the respective parameter to "true". This means that the actual value will not be considered during ECU Configuration but will be (re-)calculated by the code generator and stored in the value attribute afterwards. These implicit updated values might require a re-generation of other modules which reference these values.

If withAuto is "false" it shall not be possible to set the "isAutoValue" attribute of the respective parameter to "true".

If withAuto is not present the default is "false".

elements.description:
There are three inclusion modes how the implicit two-byte Data ID is included in the one-byte CRC:

* dataIDMode = 0: Two bytes are included in the CRC (double ID configuration) This is used in variant 1A.
* dataIDMode = 1: One of the two bytes byte is included, alternating high and low byte, depending on parity of the counter (alternating ID configuration). For even counter low byte is included; For odd counters the high byte is included. This is used in variant 1B.
* dataIDMode = 2: Only low byte is included, high byte is never used. This is applicable if the IDs in a particular system are 8 bits.
* dataIdMode = 3: The low byte is included in the implicit CRC calculation, the low nibble of the high byte is transmitted along with the data (i.e. it is explicitly included), the high nibble of the high byte is not used. This is applicable for the IDs up to 12 bits.

elements.name: dataLength
elements.description: This attribute represents the length of the Array representation of the Signal Group/VariableDataPrototype including CRC and Counter in bits.

elements.name: maxDeltaCounterInit
elements.description:
Initial maximum allowed gap between two counter values of two consecutively received valid Data, i.e. how many subsequent lost data is accepted. For example, if the receiver gets Data with counter 1 and MaxDeltaCounterInit is 1, then at the next reception the receiver can accept Counters with values 2 and 3, but not 4.

Note that if the receiver does not receive new Data at a consecutive read, then the receiver increments the tolerance by 1.

elements.name: crcOffset
elements.description: Bit offset of CRC from the beginning of the Array representation of the Signal Group/VariableDataPrototype (MSB order, bit numbering: bit 0 is the least important). The offset shall be a multiplicity of 8 and it should be 0 whenever possible. For example, offset 8 means that the CRC will take the byte 1, i.e. bits 8..15. If crcOffset is not present the value is defined by the selected profile.

elements.name: counterOffset
elements.description: Bit offset of Counter from the beginning of the Array representation of the Signal Group/VariableDataPrototype (MSB order, bit numbering: bit 0 is the least important). The offset shall be a multiplicity of 4 and it should be 8 whenever possible. For example, offset 8 means that the counter will take the low nibble of the byte 1, i.e. bits 8 .. 11. If counterOffset is not present the value is defined by the selected profile.

elements.name: maxNoNewOrRepeatedData
elements.description: The maximum amount of missing or repeated Data which the receiver does not expect to exceed under normal communication conditions.

elements.name: syncCounterInit
elements.description:
Number of Data required for validating the consistency of the counter that shall be received with a valid counter 
(i.e. counter within the allowed lock-in range) after the detection of an unexpected behavior of a received counter.

elements.name: dataIdNibbleOffset
elements.description: Bit offset of the low nibble of the high byte of Data ID. The applicability of this attribute is controlled by [constr_1261].

The EndToEndProtectionISignalIPdu element refers to the ISignalGroup that is to be protected and to the ISignalIPdu that transmits the protected ISignalGroup. The information how the referenced ISignalGroup shall be protected (through which E2E Profile and with which E2E settings) is defined in the EndToEndDescription element.

elements.name: upperHeaderBitsToShift
elements.description:
This attribute describes the number of upper-header bits to be shifted.

value = 0 or not present: shift of upper header is NOT performed.

value > 0: the E2E Transformer on the protect-side, takes the first upperHeaderBitsToShift bits from the upper buffer (e.g. SOME/IP header part generated by SOME/IP transformer) and shifts them towards the lower bytes and bits within the Data[] for the length of the E2E header (e.g. 12 bytes in case of E2E Profile 4). This means the shift distance is fixed – it depends on the E2E header size – what is configured here is the number of bits that are to be shifted. This option is defined because the Some/IP header generated by SOME/IP transformer must be, due to compatibility between non-protected and E2E-protected communication, at the same position, which is before E2E header.
