EvaluatedVariantSet.name: EvaluatedVariantSet
EvaluatedVariantSet.description:
This meta class represents the ability to express if a set of ARElements is able to support one or more particular variants.

In other words, for a given set of evaluatedElements this meta class represents a table of evaluated variants, where each PredefinedVariant represents one column. In this column each descendant swSystemconstantValue resp. postbuildVariantCriterionValue represents one entry.

In a graphical representation each swSystemconstantValueSet / postBuildVariantCriterionValueSet could be used as an intermediate headline in the table column.

If the approvalStatus is "APPROVED" it expresses that the collection of CollectableElements is known be valid for the given evaluatedVariants.

Note that the EvaluatedVariantSet is a CollectableElement. This allows to establish a hierarchy of EvaluatedVariantSets.

elements.name: approvalStatus
elements.description:
Defines the approval status of a predefined variant. Two values are predefined: "APPROVED" and "REJECTED":

* Approved variants are known to work.
* Rejected variants are known NOT to work.

Further values can be approved on a per-company basis; within AUTOSAR only "APPROVED" and "REJECTED" should be recognized.

elements.name: evaluatedElementRefs
elements.description: This represents a particular element which is evaluated in context of the EvaluatedVariants. The approvalStatus applies to this element (and all of its descendants). In other words, the referenced elements are those that were considered when the predefined variant was evaluated.

elements.name: evaluatedVariantRefs
elements.description: This metaclass represents one particular variant which was evaluated. LowerMultiplicity is set to 0 to support a stepwise approach.

EventControlledTiming.name: EventControlledTiming
EventControlledTiming.description:
Specification of a event driven sending behavior. The PDU is sent n
(numberOfRepeat + 1) times separated by the repetitionPeriod. If numberOfRepeats
= 0, then the Pdu is sent just once.

elements.name: numberOfRepetitions
elements.description: Defines the number of repetitions for the Direct/N-Times transmission mode and the event driven part of Mixed transmission mode.

elements.name: repetitionPeriod
elements.description: The repetitionPeriod specifies the time in seconds that elapses before the pdu can be sent the next time (Minimum repeat gap between two pdus). The repetitionPeriod is optional in case that no repetitions are configured.

EventHandler.name: EventHandler
EventHandler.description: Configures the outbound application endpoint a server uses to call a clients callback. Only required if the source TpPort is not dynamically assigned. If a consumed event group is referenced the configuration is only valid for this relation.

elements.name: applicationEndpointRef
elements.description:
Defines the local application endpoint used to submit an event to a subscriber.
For the submission of events the service provider may use a different TpPort address (ApplicationEndpoint) then for the response of requests.

elements.name: consumedEventGroupRefs
elements.description: All consumers of the event are referenced here.

elements.name: multicastThreshold
elements.description:
Specifies the number of subscribed clients that trigger the server to change the transmission of events to multicast.

If configured to 0 only unicast will be used.
If configured to 1 the first client will be already served by multicast.
If configured to 2 the first client will be server with unicast and as soon as the second client arrives both will be served by multicast.

This does not influence the handling of initial events, which are served using unicast only.

ExclusiveAreaNestingOrder.description: This meta-class represents the ability to define a nesting order of ExclusiveAreas. A nesting order (that may occur in the executable code) is formally defined to be able to analyze the resource locking behavior.

If the ExecutableEntity provides at least one activationReason element the RTE resp. BSW Scheduler shall provide means to read the activation vector of this executable entity execution.

If no activationReason element is provided the feature of being able to determine the activating RTEEvent is disabled for this ExecutableEntity.

ExecutionOrderConstraint.name: ExecutionOrderConstraint
ExecutionOrderConstraint.description:
This constraint is used to restrict the order of execution for a set of ExecutableEntities. The ExecutionOrderConstraint can be used in any timing view.

The various scopes for ExecutionOrderConstraint are described below. Generally, each ExecutionOrderConstraint has a scope of software components and can reference all executable entities available in the corresponding internal behavior (RunnableEntity and BswModuleEntity) either directly or by the events activating respectively starting them (RteEvent and BswEvent).

On VFB level an ExecutionOrderConstraint can be specified for RunnableEntities part of the composition hierarchy referenced by the VfbTiming. The ExecutionOrderConstraint is aggregated by the VfbTiming.

On SW-C level an ExecutionOrderConstraint can be specified for RunnableEntities part of the InternalBehavior referenced by the SwcTiming. The ExecutionOrderConstraint is aggregated by the SwcTiming.

On System level an ExecutionOrderConstraint can be specified for RunnableEntities part of the composition hierarchy of the system referenced by the SystemTiming. The ExecutionOrderConstraint is aggregated by the SystemTiming.

On BSW Module level, an ExectionOrderConstraint can be specified for BswModuleEntities part of an BswInternalBehavior referenced by the BswModuleTiming. The ExecutionOrderConstraint is aggregated by the BswModuleTiming.

On ECU level an ExecutionOrderConstraint can be specified for all ExecutableEntities and Events available via the EcucValueCollection, covering ECU Extract and BSW Module Configuration, referenced by the EcuTiming. The ExecutionOrderConstraint is aggregated by the EcuTiming.

elements.name: baseCompositionRef
elements.description: Specifies the composition SW-C type playing the role of a SW-C containing further SW-Cs and represents the scope of the Execution Order Constraint.

elements.name: executionOrderConstraintType
elements.description: Specifies the specific type of ExecutionOrderConstraint.

elements.name: isEvent
elements.description: Indicates whether the ExecutionOrderConstraint is only referring to Executable Entities (FALSE) or only to RTE and/or BSW Events (TRUE).

elements.name: orderedElements
elements.description: The list of references to ExecutableEntities which shall be ordered.

elements.name: permitMultipleReferencesToEe
elements.description: Indicates that the ExecutionOrderConstraints permits that an Executable Entity is referenced multiple times (TRUE) or only once (FALSE) in the constraint.

ExecutionTime.name: ExecutionTime
ExecutionTime.description: Base class for several means how to describe the ExecutionTime of software. The required context information is provided through this class.

elements.name: exclusiveAreaRef
elements.description: Reference to the ExclusiveArea this execution time is provided for.

elements.name: executableEntityRef
elements.description: The executable entity for which this execution time is described.

elements.name: hardwareConfiguration
elements.description: Provides information on the HardwareConfiguration used to specify this ExecutionTime.

elements.name: hwElementRef
elements.description: The hardware element (e.g. type of ECU) for which the execution time is specified.

elements.name: includedLibraryRefs
elements.description:
If this dependency is specified, the execution
time of the library code is included in the
execution time data for the runnable.

elements.name: memorySectionLocations
elements.description: Provides information on the MemorySectionLocation which is involved in the ExecutionTime description.

elements.name: softwareContext
elements.description: Provides information on the detailed SoftwareContext used to provide the ExecutionTime description.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

ExecutionTimeConstraint.name: ExecutionTimeConstraint
ExecutionTimeConstraint.description:
An ExecutionTimeConstraint is used to specify the execution time of the referenced ExecutableEntity in the referenced component. A minimum and maximum execution time can be defined. Two types of execution time semantics can be used. The desired semantics can be set by the attribute executionTimeType:
  • The "net" execution time is the time used to execute the ExecutableEntity without interruption and without external calls.
  • The "gross" execution time is the time used to execute the ExecutableEntity without interruption including external calls to other entities.
The time to execute the ExecutableEntity including interruptions by other entities and including external calls is commonly called "response time". The TimingExtensions provide the concept of event chains and latency constraints for that purpose. An event chain from the start of the entity to the termination of the entity with according latency constraint represents a response time constraint for that executable entity.

elements.name: componentIref
elements.description: The component that containts the referenced ExecutableEntity for the ExecutionTimeConstraint. If the entity is in a basic software module no component must be provided.

elements.name: executableRef
elements.description: The referenced ExecutableEntity for the ExecutionTimeConstraint.

elements.name: maximum
elements.description: The maximum execution time.

elements.name: minimum
elements.description: The minimum execution time.

ExternalTriggerOccurredEvent.name: ExternalTriggerOccurredEvent
ExternalTriggerOccurredEvent.description: The event is raised when the referenced trigger have been occurred.

elements.name: triggerIref
elements.description: Reference to the applicable Trigger.

ExternalTriggeringPoint.name: ExternalTriggeringPoint
ExternalTriggeringPoint.description: If a RunnableEntity owns an ExternalTriggeringPoint it is entitled to raise an ExternalTriggerOccurredEvent.

elements.name: ident
elements.description:
The aggregation in the role ident provides the ability to make the ExternalTriggeringPoint identifiable.

From the semantical point of view, the ExternalTriggeringPoint is considered a first-class Identifiable and therefore the aggregation in the role ident shall always exist (until it may be possible to let ModeAccessPoint directly inherit from Identifiable).

elements.name: triggerIref
elements.description: The trigger taken for the ExternalTriggeringPoint.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

ExternalTriggeringPointIdent.name: ExternalTriggeringPointIdent
ExternalTriggeringPointIdent.description: This meta-class has been created to introduce the ability to become referenced into the meta-class ExternalTriggeringPoint without breaking backwards compatibility.

FMAttributeDef.name: FMAttributeDef
FMAttributeDef.description: This metaclass represents the ability to define attributes for a feature.

elements.name: defaultValue
elements.description: This represents the default value of the attribute.

elements.name: max
elements.description: Maximum possible value for the value of this attribute

elements.name: min
elements.description: Minimum possible value for the value of this attribute

elements.name: definitionRef
elements.description: This refers to the definition of this attribute.

elements.name: value
elements.description: This represents the value of this attribute.

FMConditionByFeaturesAndAttributes.name: FMConditionByFeaturesAndAttributes
FMConditionByFeaturesAndAttributes.description: A boolean expression that has the syntax of the AUTOSAR formula language but uses only references to features or feature attributes (not system constants) as operands.

FMConditionByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts.name: FMConditionByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts
FMConditionByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts.description: A boolean expression that has the syntax of the AUTOSAR formula language and may use references to features or system constants as operands.

FMFeature.name: FMFeature
FMFeature.description: A FMFeature describes an essential characteristic of a product. Each FMFeature is contained in exactly one FMFeatureModel.

elements.name: attributeDefs
elements.description: This defines the attributes of the given feature.

elements.name: decompositions
elements.description: Lists the sub-features of a feature.

elements.name: maximumIntendedBindingTime
elements.description: Defines an upper bound for the binding time of the variation points that are associated with the FMFeature. This attribute is meant as a hint for the development process.

elements.name: minimumIntendedBindingTime
elements.description: Defines a lower bound for the binding time of the variation points that are associated with the FMFeature. This attribute is meant as a hint for the development process.

elements.name: relations
elements.description:
Defines relations for FMFeatures, for example dependencies on
other FMFeatures, or conflicts with other FMFeatures. A FMFeature
can only be part of a FMFeatureSelectionSet if all its
relations are fulfilled.

elements.name: restrictions
elements.description:
Defines restrictions for FMFeatures. A FMFeature can only be part
of a FMFeatureSelectionSet if at least one of its restrictions evaluates to true.

FMFeatureDecomposition.name: FMFeatureDecomposition
FMFeatureDecomposition.description:
A FMFeatureDecomposition describes dependencies between a list of
features and their parent feature (i.e., the FMFeature that
aggregates the FMFeatureDecomposition). The kind of dependency is
defined by the attribute category.

elements.name: category
elements.description:
The category of a FMFeatureDecomposition defines the type of
dependency that is defined by the FMFeatureDecomposition. There
are four different categories: MANDATORYFEATURE, OPTIONALFEATURE,
ALTERNATIVEFEATURE, and MULTIPLEFEATURE.

elements.name: featureRefs
elements.description: The features that are affected by the dependency defined by the FMFeatureDecomposition.

elements.name: max
elements.description: For a dependency of category MULTIPLEFEATURE, this defines the maximum number of features allowed.

elements.name: min
elements.description: For a dependency of category MULTIPLEFEATURE, this defines the minimum number of features allowed.

FMFeatureMap.name: FMFeatureMap
FMFeatureMap.description:
A FMFeatureMap associates FMFeatures with variation points in the
AUTOSAR model. To do this, it defines value sets for system
constants and postbuild variant criterions that shall be chosen 
whenever a certain combination of features (and system constants) is encountered.

elements.name: mappings
elements.description: Set of mappings defined by this FMFeatureMap.

FMFeatureMapAssertion.name: FMFeatureMapAssertion
FMFeatureMapAssertion.description: Defines a boolean expression which must evaluate to true for this mapping to become active. The expression is a formula that is based on features and system constants, and is defined by fmSyscond.

elements.name: fmSyscond
elements.description: The formula that implements the assertion.

FMFeatureMapCondition.name: FMFeatureMapCondition
FMFeatureMapCondition.description: Defines a condition which needs to be fulfilled for this mapping to become active. The condition is implemented as formula that is based on features and attributes and is defined by fmCond.

elements.name: fmCond
elements.description: The formula that implements the condition.

FMFeatureMapElement.name: FMFeatureMapElement
FMFeatureMapElement.description:
Defines value sets for system constants and postbuild variant
criterions that shall be chosen whenever a certain combination
of features (and system constants) is encountered.

elements.name: assertions
elements.description: Defines a boolean expression based on features and system constants which needs to evaluate to true for this mapping to become active.

elements.name: conditions
elements.description: Defines a condition which needs to be fulfilled for this mapping to become active.

elements.name: postBuildVariantCriterionValueSetRefs
elements.description: Selects a set of values for postbuild variant criterions.

elements.name: swSystemconstantValueSetRefs
elements.description: Selects a set of values for system constants.

FMFeatureModel.name: FMFeatureModel
FMFeatureModel.description: A Feature model describes the features of a product line and their dependencies. Feature models are an optional part of an AUTOSAR model.

elements.name: featureRefs
elements.description: "feature" holds the list of features of the feature model. No FMFeature may be contained twice in this list. Also, each FMFeature may be contained on only one feature model.

elements.name: rootRef
elements.description: The features of a feature model define a tree. The attribute root points to the root of this tree.

FMFeatureRelation.name: FMFeatureRelation
FMFeatureRelation.description:
Defines relations for FMFeatures, for example dependencies on
other FMFeatures, or conflicts with other FMFeatures. A FMFeature
can only be part of a FMFeatureSelectionSet if all its
relations are fulfilled.

elements.name: featureRefs
elements.description: The FMFeature that is targeted by this FMFeatureRelation.

FMFeatureRestriction.name: FMFeatureRestriction
FMFeatureRestriction.description:
Defines restrictions for FMFeatures. A FMFeature can only be part
of a FMFeatureSelectionSet if at least one of its restrictions evaluate to true.

elements.name: restriction
elements.description: A formula that contains the actual restriction.

FMFeatureSelection.name: FMFeatureSelection
FMFeatureSelection.description:
A FMFeatureSelection represents the state of a particular
FMFeature within a FMFeatureSelectionSet.

elements.name: featureRef
elements.description: The FMFeature whose state is defined by this FMFeatureSelection.

elements.name: state
elements.description:
Defines how the FMFeature that is described by this
FMFeatureSelection contributes to the FMFeatureSelectionSet. A
FMFeature may have the state selected, deselected or undecided.

elements.name: minimumSelectedBindingTime
elements.description: Defines a lower bound for the binding time of the variation points that are associated with the FMFeature, and refines its minimumIntendedBindingTime. This attribute is meant as a hint for the development process.

elements.name: maximumSelectedBindingTime
elements.description: Defines an upper bound for the binding time of the variation points that are associated with the FMFeature, and refines its maximumIntendedBindingTime. This attribute is meant as a hint for the development process.

elements.name: attributeValues
elements.description:
This defines a value for the attribute that is referred to in the role definition.

Note that a FMFeatureSelection cannot include two FMAttributeValues that refer to the same FMAttributeDef in the role definition.

FMFeatureSelectionSet.name: FMFeatureSelectionSet
FMFeatureSelectionSet.description: A FMFeatureSelectionSet is a set of FMFeatures that describes a specific product.

elements.name: featureModelRefs
elements.description:
All FMFeatures in this FMFeatureSelectionSet shall be part of the
referenced FMFeatureModel.

elements.name: includeRefs
elements.description:
Each FMFeatureSelectionSet may include one or more
FMFeatureSelectionSets. This establishes a hierarchy among
FMFeatureSelectionSets. See constr_5003 and constr_5025 for
details.

elements.name: selections
elements.description: The set of FMFeatureSelections of this FMFeatureSelectionSet.

FMFormulaByFeaturesAndAttributes.name: FMFormulaByFeaturesAndAttributes
FMFormulaByFeaturesAndAttributes.description: An expression that has the syntax of the AUTOSAR formula language but uses only references to features or feature attributes (not system constants) as operands.

elements.name: attributeRef
elements.description: An expression of type FMFormulaByFeaturesAndAttributes may refer to attributes of FMFeatures.

elements.name: featureRef
elements.description: An expression of type FMFormulaByFeaturesAndAttributes may refer to FMFeatures.

FMFormulaByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts.name: FMFormulaByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts
FMFormulaByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts.description: An expression that has the syntax of the AUTOSAR formula language and may use references to features or system constants as operands.

elements.name: featureRef
elements.description: An expression of type FMFormulaByFeaturesAndSwSystemconsts may refer to FMFeatures.

FibexElement.name: FibexElement
FibexElement.description: ASAM FIBEX elements specifying Communication and Topology.

FibexElementRefConditional.name: FibexElementRefConditional
FibexElementRefConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlatInstanceDescriptor.name: FlatInstanceDescriptor
FlatInstanceDescriptor.description:
Represents exactly one node (e.g. a component instance or data element) of the instance tree of a software system. The purpose of this element is to map the various nested representations of this instance to a flat representation and assign a unique name (shortName) to it.

Use cases: 
* Specify unique names of measurable data to be used by MCD tools
* Specify unique names of calibration data to be used by MCD tool
* Specify a unique name for an instance of a component prototype in the ECU extract of the system description

Note that in addition it is possible to assign alias names via AliasNameAssignment.

elements.name: role
elements.description:
The role denotes the particular role of the downstream memory location described by this FlatInstanceDescriptor.

It applies to use case where one upstream object results in multiple downstream objects, e.g. ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes which are measurable. In this case the RTE will provide locations for current mode, previous mode and next mode.

elements.name: swDataDefProps
elements.description: The properties of this FlatInstanceDescriptor.

elements.name: upstreamReferenceIref
elements.description:
Refers to the instance in the context of an "upstream" descriptions, wich could be the system or system extract description, the basic software module description or (if a flat map is used in preliminary context) a description of an atomic component or composition. This reference is optional in case the flat map is used in ECU context.

The reference shall be such that it uniquely defines the object instance in the given context. For example, if a data prototype is declared as a role within an SwcInternalBehavior, it is not enough to state the SwcInternalBehavior as context and the aggregated data prototype as target. In addition, the reference shall also include the complete path identifying the instance of the component prototype that contains the particular instance of SwcInternalBehavior.

elements.name: ecuExtractReferenceIref
elements.description:
Refers to the instance in the ECU extract. This is valid only, if the FlatMap is used in the context of an ECU extract.

The reference shall be such that it uniquely defines the object instance. For example, if a data prototype is declared as a role within an SwcInternalBehavior, it is not enough to state the SwcInternalBehavior as context and the aggregated data prototype as target. In addition, the reference shall also include the complete path identifying instance of the component prototype and the AtomicSoftwareComponentType, which is refered by the particular SwcInternalBehavior.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlatMap.name: FlatMap
FlatMap.description:
Contains a flat list of references to software objects. This list is used to identify instances and to resolve name conflicts. The scope is given by the RootSwCompositionPrototype for which it is used, i.e. it can be applied to a system, system extract or ECU-extract.

An instance of FlatMap may also be used in a preliminary context, e.g. in the scope of a software component before integration into a system. In this case it is not referred by a RootSwCompositionPrototype.

elements.name: instances
elements.description:
A descriptor instance aggregated in the flat map. 

The variation point accounts for the fact, that the system in scope can be subject to variability, and thus the existence of some instances is variable.

The aggregation has been made splitable because the content might be contributed by different stakeholders at different times in the workflow. Plus, the overall size might be so big that eventually it becomes more manageable if it is distributed over several files.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming.name: FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming
FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming.description:
Each frame in FlexRay is identified by its slot id and communication cycle. A description is provided by the usage of AbsolutelyScheduledTiming. 

In the static segment a frame can be sent multiple times within one communication cycle. For describing this case multiple AbsolutelyScheduledTimings have to be used. The main use case would be that a frame is sent twice within one communication cycle.

elements.name: communicationCycle
elements.description: The communication cycle where the frame is sent.

elements.name: slotId
elements.description:
In the static part the SlotID defines the slot in which the frame is transmitted. 
The SlotID also determines, in combination with FlexrayCluster::numberOfStaticSlots, whether the frame is sent in static or dynamic segment. 
In the dynamic part, the slot id is equivalent to a priority. Lower dynamic slot ids are all sent until the end of the dynamic segment. Higher numbers, which were ignored that time, have to wait one cycle and then must try again.

minValue: 1
maxValue: 2047

FlexrayArTpChannel.name: FlexrayArTpChannel
FlexrayArTpChannel.description:
A channel is a group of connections sharing several properties.

The FlexRay AutosarTransport Layer supports several channels. These channels can work concurrently, thus each of them requires its own state machine and management data structures and its own PDU-IDs.

elements.name: ackType
elements.description: Type of Acknowledgement.

elements.name: cancellation
elements.description: With this switch Tx and Rx Cancellation can be turned on or off.

elements.name: extendedAddressing
elements.description:
Adressing Type of this connection:
true: Two Bytes
false: One Byte

elements.name: flowControlPduRef
elements.description:
Reference to the  Flow Control NPdu.
Please note that this reference is deprecated and will be removed in future.

elements.name: maxAr
elements.description: This attribute defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when a TIMEOUT AR occurs (depending on whether retry is configured).

elements.name: maxAs
elements.description: This attribute defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when a TIMEOUT AS occurs (depending on whether retry is configured).

elements.name: maxBs
elements.description: This attribute defines the number of consecutive CFs between two FCs (block size). Valid values are 1 .. 16 when retry is activated, and 0 .. 255 otherwise.

elements.name: maxBufferRequest
elements.description:
Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

maxFcWait will be used instead to configure the maximum number of wait frames on receiver side. On the sender side, timeCs defines the maximum time for retries.

elements.name: maxFcWait
elements.description: This attribute defines the maximal number of wait frames to be sent for a pending connection. Range is 0..255.

elements.name: maxFrIf
elements.description:
Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

Old description:
This attribute defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when the FrIf returns an error.

elements.name: maxRetries
elements.description: This attribute defines the maximum number of retries (if retry is configured for the particular channel).

elements.name: maximumMessageLength
elements.description: This specifies the maximum message length for the particular channel.

elements.name: minimumMulticastSeperationTime
elements.description:
This attribute defines the minimum amount of time between two succeeding CFs of a 1:n segmented transmission in seconds. Valid values are 0, 100µs, 200µs ... 900µs, 1ms, 2ms .. 127ms. The value can be changed at runtime using the FrArTp_ChangeParameter interface.

minimumMulticastSeparationTime must be an integer multiple of the cycle length multiplied with the multiplexing factor, i.e. minimumMulticastSeparationTime = n * cycle * m, where n is an integer >= 0, cycle is FlexrayCluster.cycle, and m is the cycle multiplexor of those cycles where PDUs of the PDU pool are scheduled. 
Please note: Due to the scheduling strategies of FrTp, minimumMulticastSeparationTime can only be kept to a degree defined by the maximum temporal distance of the PDUs of a PDU pool within one FlexRay cycle.

Range: 0 .. 0.127

elements.name: minimumSeparationTime
elements.description:
This attribute defines the minimum amount of time between two succeeding CFs of a 1:1 segmented transmission in seconds. Valid values are 0, 100µs, 200µs .. 900µs, 1ms, 2ms .. 127ms. The value can be changed at runtime using the FrArTp_ChangeParameter interface.

The minimumSeparationTime must be an integer multiple of the cycle length multiplied with the multiplexing factor, i.e. minimumSeparationTime = n * cycle * m, where n is an integer >=0, cycle is FlexrayCluster.cycle, and m is the cycle multiplexor of those cycles where PDUs of the PDU pool are scheduled. 

Please note: Due to the scheduling strategies of FrTp, minimumSeparationTime can only be kept to a degree defined by the maximum temporal distance of the PDUs of a PDU pool within one FlexRay cycle.

Range: 0 .. 0.127

elements.name: multicastSegmentation
elements.description: This attribute defines whether segmentation within a 1:n connection is allowed or not.

elements.name: nPduRefs
elements.description: A FlexRayTpChannel references a set of NPdus. These NPdus are logically assembled into a pool of Rx NPdus and another pool of Tx NPdus. It must be ensured that a second channel either references all NPdus of such a pool, or none.

elements.name: pduPools
elements.description:
Please note that this aggregation is deprecated and will be removed in future. 
The nPdu reference will be used instead.

elements.name: timeBr
elements.description: This attribute defines the time in seconds between receiving the last CF of a block or an FF-x (or SF-x) and sending out an FC or AF.

elements.name: timeBuffer
elements.description:
Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

timeBr will be used instead to configure the delay between two wait frames (and thus two buffer requests) on receiver side. On sender side, the main task cycle will be used.

elements.name: timeCs
elements.description: This attribute defines the time in seconds between the sending of two consecutive frames or between a consecutive frame and a flow control (for Transmit Cancellation) or between reception of an flow control or Acknowledgement Frame and sending of the next consecutive frame or a  flow control (for Transmit Cancellation).

elements.name: timeFrIf
elements.description:
Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

Old description:
This attribute defines the time in seconds of waiting for the next try (if retry is activated) to send via FrIf_Transmit. Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeoutAr
elements.description: This attribute states the timeout in seconds between the PDU transmit request of the Transport Layer to the FlexRay Interface and the corresponding confirmation of the FlexRay Interface on the receiver side (for FC or AF).

elements.name: timeoutAs
elements.description: This attribute states the timeout in seconds between the PDU transmit request for the first PDU of the group used in the current connection of the Transport Layer to the FlexRay Interface and the corresponding confirmation of the FlexRay Interface (when having sent the last PDU of the group used in this connection) on the sender side (SF-x, FF-x, CF).

elements.name: timeoutBs
elements.description: This attribute defines the timeout in seconds for waiting for an FC or AF on the sender side in a 1:1 connection.

elements.name: timeoutCr
elements.description: This attribute defines the timeout value in seconds for waiting for a CF or FF-x (in case of retry) after receiving the last CF or after sending an FC or AF on the receiver side.

elements.name: tpConnections
elements.description: Group of connections that can be used in this channel.

elements.name: transmitCancellation
elements.description:
This attribute states whether Transmit Cancellation is supported on this channel. When not set, the value of this attribute may be specified by the ECU integrator.

Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

FlexrayArTpConfig.description:

One FlexrayArTpConfig element shall be created for each FlexRay Network in the System that uses FlexRay Autosar TP.

FlexrayArTpConnection.name: FlexrayArTpConnection
FlexrayArTpConnection.description:
A connection within a channel identifies the sender and the receiver of this particular communication.

The FlexRay Autosar Tp module routes a Pdu through this connection.

elements.name: connectionPrioPdus
elements.description: This parameter defines the number of PDUs that shall be reserved for this connection when it is active. The range is 1-255.

elements.name: directTpSduRef
elements.description:
Reference to the IPdu that is segmented by the Transport Protocol. 

The source address of the transmitted NPdu is determined by the configured source CommunicationConnector.
The target address of the transmitted NPdu is determined by the configured target CommunicationConnector.

elements.name: flowControlPduRef
elements.description:
Please note that this reference is deprecated and will be removed in future. 
The PDU pool referenced by the FlexRayArTpChannel as nPdu will be used instead.

elements.name: multicastRef
elements.description: TP address for 1:n connections.

elements.name: reversedTpSduRef
elements.description:
Reference to the IPdu that is segmented by the Transport Protocol. 
If support of both sending and receiving is used, this association references the IPdu used for the additional second direction.

The source address of the transmitted NPdu is determined by the configured target CommunicationConnector.
The target address of the transmitted NPdu is determined by the configured source CommunicationConnector.

elements.name: sourceRef
elements.description: The source of the TP connection.

elements.name: targetRefs
elements.description: The target of the TP connection.

elements.name: transmitPduRefs
elements.description:
Please note that this reference is deprecated and will be removed in future. 
The PDU pool referenced by the FlexRayArTpChannel as nPdu will be used instead.

FlexrayArTpNode.name: FlexrayArTpNode
FlexrayArTpNode.description: TP Node (Sender or Receiver) provides the TP Address and the connection to the Topology description.

elements.name: connectorRefs
elements.description:
Association  to one or more physical connectors (max number of connectors for FlexRay: 2).

In a System Description this reference is mandatory. In an ECU Extract this reference is optional (references to ECUs that are not part of the ECU Extract shall be avoided).

elements.name: tpAddressRef
elements.description: Reference to the TP Address that is used by the TpNode. This reference is optional in case that the multicast TP Address is used (reference from TpConnection).

Maximum cycle counter value in a given cluster.
Remark: Set to 63 for FlexRay Protocol 2.1 Rev. A compliance.

elements.name: ignoreAfterTx

elements.name: listenNoise

elements.name: macroPerCycle
elements.description: The number of macroticks in a communication cycle

elements.name: macrotickDuration
elements.description: Duration of the cluster wide nominal macrotick, expressed in s.

elements.name: maxWithoutClockCorrectionFatal
elements.description: Threshold concerning vClockCorrectionFailedCounter. Defines the number of consecutive even/odd Cycle pairs with missing clock correction terms that will cause the protocol to transition from the POC:normal active or POC:normal passive state into the POC:halt state.

elements.name: maxWithoutClockCorrectionPassive
elements.description: Threshold concerning vClockCorrectionFailedCounter. Defines the number of consecutive even/odd Cycle pairs with missing clock correction terms that will cause the protocol to transition from the POC:normal active state to the POC:normal passive state.

elements.name: minislotActionPointOffset
elements.description: The Offset of the action point within a minislot. Unit: macroticks

elements.name: minislotDuration

elements.name: networkIdleTime

elements.name: networkManagementVectorLength
elements.description: Length of the Network Management vector in a cluster [bytes]

elements.name: numberOfMinislots
elements.description: Number of Minislots in the dynamic segment.

elements.name: numberOfStaticSlots
elements.description: The number of static slots in the static segment.

elements.name: offsetCorrectionStart
elements.description: Start of the offset correction phase within the Network Idle Time (NIT), expressed as the number of macroticks from the start of cycle. Unit: macroticks

elements.name: payloadLengthStatic
elements.description: Globally configured payload length of a static frame. Unit: 16-bit WORDS.

elements.name: safetyMargin
elements.description: Additional timespan in macroticks which takes jitter into account to be able to set the JobListPointer to the next possible job which can be executed in case the FlexRay Job List Execution Function has be resynchronized.

elements.name: sampleClockPeriod
elements.description: Sample clock period. Unit: seconds

elements.name: staticSlotDuration
elements.description: The duration of a slot in the static segment. Unit: macroticks

elements.name: symbolWindow
elements.description: The duration of the symbol window. Unit: macroticks

elements.name: symbolWindowActionPointOffset
elements.description: Number of macroticks the action point offset is from the beginning of the symbol window [Macroticks].

elements.name: syncFrameIdCountMax
elements.description: Maximum number of distinct syncframe identifiers present in a given cluster. This parameter maps to FlexRay Protocol 2.1  Rev. A parameter gSyncNodeMax.

elements.name: tranceiverStandbyDelay
elements.description:
The duration of timer t_TrcvStdbyDelay in seconds. The granularity of this parameter shall be restricted to full FlexRay cycles (cycle). The transceiver status setting to STANDBY shall be delayed by this value.

Not specifying a value or a value of 0 shall imply that the timer is not used.

elements.name: transmissionStartSequenceDuration
elements.description: Number of bits in the Transmission Start Sequence [gdBits].

elements.name: wakeupRxIdle
elements.description:
Number of bits used by the node to test the duration of the 'idle' or HIGH phase of a received wakeup. 
Unit:bitDuration
Remarks: This parameter maps to FlexRay Protocol 2.1 Rev. A parameter gdWakeupSymbolRxIdle.

elements.name: wakeupRxLow
elements.description:
Number of bits used by the node to test the duration of the LOW phase of a received wakeup. Unit:bitDuration 
Remarks: This parameter maps to FlexRay Protocol 2.1 Rev. A parameter gdWakeupSymbolRxLow.

elements.name: wakeupRxWindow
elements.description:
The size of the window used to detect wakeups [gdBit]. 
Remarks: This parameter maps to FlexRay Protocol 2.1 Rev. A parameter gdWakeupSymbolRxWindow.

elements.name: wakeupTxActive
elements.description: Number of bits used by the node to transmit the LOW phase of awakeup symbol and  the HIGH and LOW phases of a WUDOP. Unit:bitDuration

elements.name: wakeupTxIdle
elements.description:
Number of bits used by the node to transmit the 'idle' part of a
wakeup symbol. 
Unit: gDbit

FlexrayCommunicationConnector.name: FlexrayCommunicationConnector
FlexrayCommunicationConnector.description: FlexRay specific attributes to the CommunicationConnector

elements.name: nmReadySleepTime
elements.description: The value of this attribute influences the shutdown behavior of the FlexRay NM. FrNm switches to bus sleep mode nmReadySleepTime seconds after  the completion of the last repetition cycle containing a NM vote.

elements.name: pncFilterDataMask
elements.description:
Bit mask for FlexRay Payload used to configure the FlexRay Transceiver for partial network wakeup.

This attribute should not be computed from the pncIdentifier values in order to support future introduction of additional PNCs. 

Note that for one EcuInstance all contributing pncFilterDataMask will be bitwise ORed to obtain the value of FrNmPnFilterMaskByte. Note that this data mask is calculated over the whole payload (8 Byte) of the NmPdu ignoring the leading bytes which do not contain pncVector information. The number of leading bytes which shall be ignored is equivalent to the value of System.pncVectorOffset.

elements.name: wakeUpChannel
elements.description: Referenced channel used by the node to send a wakeup pattern. (pWakeupChannel)

FlexrayCommunicationController.name: FlexrayCommunicationController
FlexrayCommunicationController.description: FlexRay bus specific communication port attributes.

elements.name: flexrayCommunicationControllerVariants
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayCommunicationControllerConditiona.name: FlexrayCommunicationControllerConditional
FlexrayCommunicationControllerConditiona.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayCommunicationControllerContent.name: FlexrayCommunicationControllerContent
FlexrayCommunicationControllerContent.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: acceptedStartupRange
elements.description: Expanded range of measured clock deviation allowed for startup frames during integration. Unit:microtick

elements.name: allowHaltDueToClock
elements.description:
Boolean flag that controls the transition to the POC:halt state due to a clock synchronization errors. 
If set to true, the Communication Controller is allowed to transition to POC:halt. 
If set to false, the Communication Controller will not transition to the POC:halt state but will enter or remain in the normal POC (passive State).

elements.name: allowPassiveToActive
elements.description: Number of consecutive even/odd cycle pairs that must have valid clock correction terms before the Communication Controller will be allowed to transition from the POC:normal passive state to POC:normal active state. If set to 0, the Communication Controller is not allowed to transition from POC:norm

elements.name: clusterDriftDamping
elements.description: The cluster drift damping factor used in clock synchronization rate correction in microticks

elements.name: decodingCorrection
elements.description: Value used by the receiver to calculate the difference between primary time reference point and secondary time reference point. Unit: Microticks (pDecodingCorrection)

elements.name: delayCompensationA
elements.description: Value used to compensate for reception delays on channel A Unit: Microticks. This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel A is used.

elements.name: delayCompensationB
elements.description: Value used to compensate for reception delays on channel B. Unit: Microticks. This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel B is used.

elements.name: externOffsetCorrection
elements.description: Fixed amount added or subtracted to the calculated offset correction term to facilitate external offset correction, expressed in node-local microticks.

elements.name: externRateCorrection
elements.description: Fixed amount added or subtracted to the calculated rate correction term to facilitate external rate correction, expressed in node-local microticks.

elements.name: externalSync
elements.description: Flag indicating whether the node is externally synchronized (operating as Time Gateway Sink in an TT-E Time Triggered External Sync cluster) or locally synchronized.

elements.name: fallBackInternal
elements.description: Flag indicating whether a Time Gateway Sink node will switch to local clock operation when synchronization with the Time Gateway Source node is lost (pFallBackInternal = true) or will instead go to POC:ready (pFallBackInternal = false).

elements.name: flexrayFifos
elements.description: One First In First Out (FIFO) queued receive structure, defining the admittance criteria to the FIFO.

elements.name: keySlotId
elements.description:
ID of the slot used to transmit the startup frame, sync frame, or designated single slot frame.
If the attributes keySlotUsedForStartUp, keySlotUsedForSync, or keySlotOnlyEnabled are set to true the key slot value is mandatory.

elements.name: keySlotOnlyEnabled
elements.description: Flag indicating whether or not the node shall enter key slot only mode following startup.

elements.name: keySlotUsedForStartUp
elements.description: Flag indicating whether the Key Slot is used to transmit a startup frame.

elements.name: keySlotUsedForSync
elements.description: Flag indicating whether the Key Slot is used to transmit a sync frame.

elements.name: latestTx
elements.description: The number of the last minislot in which a transmission can start in the dynamic segment for the respective node

elements.name: listenTimeout
elements.description: Value for the startup listen timeout and wakeup listen timeout. Although this is a node local parameter, the real time equivalent of this value should be the same for all nodes in the cluster. Unit: Microticks

elements.name: macroInitialOffsetA
elements.description: Integer number of macroticks between the static slot boundary and the closest macrotick boundary of the secondary time reference point based on the nominal macrotick duration. (pMacroInitialOffset). This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel A is used.

elements.name: macroInitialOffsetB
elements.description: Integer number of macroticks between the static slot boundary and the closest macrotick boundary of the secondary time reference point based on the nominal macrotick duration. (pMacroInitialOffset). This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel B is used.

elements.name: maximumDynamicPayloadLength
elements.description: Maximum payload length for the dynamic channel of a frame in 16 bit WORDS.

elements.name: microInitialOffsetA
elements.description: Number of microticks between the closest macrotick boundary described by gMacroInitialOffset and the secondary time reference point.  The parameter depends on pDelayCompensationA and therefore it has to be set independently for each channel. This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel A is used.

elements.name: microInitialOffsetB
elements.description: Number of microticks between the closest macrotick boundary described by gMacroInitialOffset and the secondary time reference point.  The parameter depends on pDelayCompensationB and therefore it has to be set independently for each channel. This optional parameter shall only be filled out if channel B is used.

elements.name: microPerCycle
elements.description: The nominal number of microticks in a communication cycle

elements.name: microtickDuration
elements.description:
Duration of a microtick. This attribute can be derived from samplePerMicrotick and gdSampleClockPeriod. 
Unit: seconds

elements.name: nmVectorEarlyUpdate
elements.description: Flag indicating when the update of the Network Management Vector in the CHI shall take place. If set to false, the update shall take place after the NIT. If set to true, the update shall take place after the end of the static segment.

elements.name: offsetCorrectionOut
elements.description: Magnitude of the maximum permissible offset correction value. Unit:microtick (pOffsetCorrectionOut)

elements.name: rateCorrectionOut
elements.description:
Magnitude of the maximum permissible rate correction value and the maximum drift offset between two nodes operating with unsynchronized clocks for one communication cycle. Unit:Microticks (pRateCorrectionOut)

Remarks: This parameter maps to FlexRay 
Protocol 2.1 Rev. A parameter pdMaxDrift.

elements.name: samplesPerMicrotick
elements.description: Number of samples per microtick

elements.name: secondKeySlotId
elements.description: ID of the second Key slot, in which a second startup frame shall be sent in TT-L Time Triggered Local Master Sync or TT-E Time Triggered External Sync mode. If this parameter is set to zero the node does not have a second key slot.

elements.name: twoKeySlotMode
elements.description: Flag indicating whether node operates as a startup node in a TT-E Time Triggered External Sync or TT-L Time Triggered Local Master Sync cluster.

elements.name: wakeUpPattern
elements.description: Number of repetitions of the Tx-wakeup symbol to be sent during the CC_WakeupSend state of this Node in the cluster

FlexrayFifoConfiguration.name: FlexrayFifoConfiguration
FlexrayFifoConfiguration.description: One First In First Out (FIFO) queued receive structure, defining the admittance criteria to the FIFO, and mandating the ability to admit messages into the FIFO based on Message Id filtering criteria.

elements.name: admitWithoutMessageId
elements.description: Boolean configuration which determines whether or not frames received in the dynamic segment that don't contain a message ID will be admitted into the FIFO.

elements.name: baseCycle
elements.description: FIFO cycle counter acceptance criteria.

elements.name: channelRef
elements.description: Fifo channel admittance criteria.

elements.name: cycleRepetition
elements.description: FIFO cycle counter acceptance criteria.

elements.name: fifoDepth
elements.description: FrFifoDepth configures the maximum number of rx-frames which can be contained in the FIFO.

elements.name: fifoRanges
elements.description: FIFO Frame Id range acceptance criteria.

elements.name: msgIdMask
elements.description: FIFO message identifier acceptance criteria (Mask filter).

elements.name: msgIdMatch
elements.description: FIFO message identifier acceptance criteria (Match filter).

FlexrayFifoRange.name: FlexrayFifoRange
FlexrayFifoRange.description: FIFO Frame Id range acceptance criteria.

elements.name: rangeMax
elements.description: Max Range.

elements.name: rangeMin
elements.description: Min Range.

FlexrayFrameTriggering.name: FlexrayFrameTriggering
FlexrayFrameTriggering.description: FlexRay specific attributes to the FrameTriggering

elements.name: absolutelyScheduledTimings
elements.description: Specification of a sending behaviour where the exact time for the frames transmission is guaranteed.

elements.name: allowDynamicLSduLength
elements.description:
Allows L-PDU length reduction and indicates that the related CC buffer has to be reconfigured for the actual length and Header-CRC before transmission of the L-PDU. 

If this attribute is set to true than the referenced Frame length attribute defines the max. length.

elements.name: messageId
elements.description: The first two bytes of the payload segment of the FlexRay frame format for frames transmitted in the dynamic segment can be used as receiver filterable data called the message ID.

elements.name: payloadPreambleIndicator
elements.description: Switching the Payload Preamble bit.

elements.name: nmCarWakeUpBitPosition
elements.description: Specifies the bit position of the CarWakeUp within the NmPdu.

elements.name: nmCarWakeUpFilterEnabled
elements.description: If this attribute is set to true the CareWakeUp filtering is supported. In this case only the CarWakeUp bit within the NmPdu with source node identifier nmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId is considered as CarWakeUp request.

elements.name: nmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId
elements.description: Source node identifier for CarWakeUp filtering. If CarWakeUp filtering is supported (nmCarWakeUpFilterEnabled), only the CarWakeUp bit within the NmPdu with source node identifier nmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId is considered as CarWakeUp request.

elements.name: nmCarWakeUpRxEnabled
elements.description: If set to true this attribute enables the support of CarWakeUp bit evaluation in received NmPdus.

elements.name: nmControlBitVectorActive
elements.description: Used to activate or deactivate the control bit vector support for a Fr Nm Channel.

elements.name: nmDataCycle
elements.description: Number of FlexRay Communication Cycles needed to transmit the Nm Data PDUs of all FlexRay Nm Ecus of this FlexRayNmCluster.

elements.name: nmDataEnabled
elements.description:
Switch to enable the separated sending of NM-Data. 
True: enables
False: disables

elements.name: nmDetectionLock
elements.description: The time for which a node will not set the repeat message request bit even in the presence of a repeat message request (in seconds).

elements.name: nmMainFunctionPeriod
elements.description: Defines the processing cycle of the main function of FrNm module.

elements.name: nmMessageTimeoutTime
elements.description: Timeout of a NmPdu in seconds. It determines how long the NM shall wait with notification of transmission failure while communication errors occur on the bus.

elements.name: nmReadySleepCount
elements.description:
This attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.
nmReadySleepTime in the FlexrayCommunicationConnector shall be used instead to influence the shutdown behavior of the FlexRay Nm.

Old description:
Numbers of repetitions in the ready sleep state before NM switches to bus sleep mode. On a value of "1", the NM-State Machine will leave the Ready Sleep State after one NM Repetition Cycle with no "keep awake" votes.

elements.name: nmRemoteSleepIndicationTime
elements.description: Timeout for Remote Sleep Indication in seconds. It defines the time how long it shall take to recognize that all other nodes are ready to sleep.

elements.name: nmRepeatMessageBitActive
elements.description: Used to activate or deactivate the repeat message bit support for a Fr Nm Channel.

elements.name: nmRepeatMessageTime
elements.description: Timeout for Repeat Message State in seconds. Defines the time how long the NM shall stay in the Repeat Message State.

elements.name: nmRepetitionCycle
elements.description: Number of FlexRay Communication Cycles used to repeat the transmission of the Nm vote Pdus of all FlexRay NmEcus of this FlexRayNmCluster.  This value must be an integral multiple of nmVotingCycle.

elements.name: nmVotingCycle
elements.description: Number of FlexRay CommunicationCycles needed to transmit the Nm vote of Pdus of all FlexRay NmEcus of this FlexRayNmCluster.

FlexrayNmClusterCoupling.name: FlexrayNmClusterCoupling
FlexrayNmClusterCoupling.description: FlexRay attributes that are valid for each of the referenced (coupled) FlexRay clusters.

elements.name: coupledClusterRefs
elements.description: Reference to coupled FlexRay Clusters.

elements.name: nmControlBitVectorEnabled
elements.description: Enables control bit vector support.

elements.name: nmDataDisabled
elements.description: Disables the transmission of NM-Data.

elements.name: nmScheduleVariant
elements.description: FrNm schedule variant according to FrNm SWS.

elements.name: nmHwVoteEnabled
elements.description: Switch for enabling the processing of FlexRay Hardware aggregated NM-Votes.

elements.name: nmMainFunctionAcrossFrCycle
elements.description: Parameter describing if the execution of the FrNm_Main function crosses theFlexRay cycle boundary or not.

elements.name: nmRepeatMessageBitEnable
elements.description: Enables/disables the repeat message bit support

elements.name: nmInstanceId
elements.description: The NM instance identifier is used for reporting of development errors to DET. It must be unique for each NM instance within one ECU.

FlexrayPhysicalChannel.name: FlexrayPhysicalChannel
FlexrayPhysicalChannel.description: FlexRay specific attributes to the physicalChannel

elements.name: channelName
elements.description: Name of the channel (Channel A or Channel B).

FlexrayTpConfig.name: FlexrayTpConfig
FlexrayTpConfig.description:
This element defines exactly one FlexRay ISO TP Configuration. 

One FlexRayTpConfig element shall be created for each FlexRay Network in the System that uses FlexRay Iso Tp.

elements.name: pduPools
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: tpAddresss
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: tpConnections
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: tpConnectionControls
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: tpEcus
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: tpNodes
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

FlexrayTpConnection.name: FlexrayTpConnection
FlexrayTpConnection.description:
A connection identifies the sender and the receiver of this particular communication. The FlexRayTp module routes a Pdu through this connection. 

In a System Description the references to the PduPools are mandatory. In an ECU Extract these references can be optional:
On unicast connections these references are always mandatory.
On multicast the txPduPool is mandatory on the sender side. The rxPduPool is mandatory on the receiver side. On Gateway ECUs both references are mandatory.

elements.name: bandwidthLimitation
elements.description: Specifies whether the connection requires a  bandwidth limitation or not.

elements.name: directTpSduRef
elements.description: Reference to the IPdu that is segmented by the Transport Protocol.

elements.name: multicastRef
elements.description: TP address for 1:n connections.

elements.name: receiverRefs
elements.description: The target of the TP connection.

elements.name: reversedTpSduRef
elements.description: Reference to the IPdu that is segmented by the Transport Protocol. If support of both sending and receiving is used, this association references the IPdu used for the additional second direction.

elements.name: rxPduPoolRef
elements.description:
A connection has a reference to a set of NPdus (FrTpRxPduPool) which are
defined for receiving data via this particular connection. 

The following constraint is valid only for the System Extract/ECU Extract:
In case this connection is applied to the transmitter the rxPduPool holds the
actually received NPdus. In case this connection is applied to the receiver the rxPduPool holds the actually sent NPdus.

elements.name: tpConnectionControlRef
elements.description: Reference to the connection control.

elements.name: transmitterRef
elements.description: The source of the TP connection.

elements.name: txPduPoolRef
elements.description:
A connection has a reference to a set of NPdus (FrTpTxPduPool) which are
defined for sending data via this particular connection.

The following constraint is valid only for the System Extract/ECU Extract:
In case this connection is applied to the transmitter the txPduPool holds the
actually sent NPdus. In case this connection is applied to the receiver the
txPduPool holds the actually received NPdus.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayTpConnectionControl.name: FlexrayTpConnectionControl
FlexrayTpConnectionControl.description: Configuration parameters to control a FlexRay TP connection.

elements.name: ackType
elements.description: This parameter defines the type of acknowledgement which is used for the specific channel.

elements.name: maxAr
elements.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when a TIMEOUT AR occurs (depending on whether retry is configured).

elements.name: maxAs
elements.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when a TIMEOUT AS occurs (depending on whether retry is configured)

elements.name: maxBufferSize
elements.description: This parameter is only relevant when having retry activated. It limits the maximal buffer size the FrTp can choose in order to limit the amount of Tx buffer that will be requested at the sender side in a segmented transfer. Unit: byte.

elements.name: maxFcWait
elements.description: This attribute defines the maximum number of FlowControl N-PDUs with FlowState "WAIT".

elements.name: maxFrIf
elements.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of trying to send a frame when the FrIf returns an error

elements.name: maxNumberOfNpduPerCycle
elements.description: This parameter limits the number of N-Pdus the sender is allowed to transmit within a FlexRay cycle.

elements.name: maxRetries
elements.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of retries (if retry is configured for the particular channel).

elements.name: separationCycleExponent
elements.description: Exponent to calculate the minimum number of "Separation Cycles" the sender has to wait for the next transmission of an FrTp N-Pdu.

elements.name: timeBr
elements.description: Time (in seconds) until transmission of the next FlowControl N-PDU.

elements.name: timeBuffer
elements.description:
This parameter defines the time of waiting for the next try to get a Tx or Rx buffer.

This parameter is equivalent to the temporal distance between two FC.WT N-Pdus in case the buffer request returns busy.

Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeCs
elements.description: Time (in seconds) until transmission of the next ConsecutiveFrame NPdu / LastFrame NPdu.

elements.name: timeFrIf
elements.description: This parameter defines the time of waiting for the next try to send. Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeoutAr
elements.description: This parameter states the timeout between the PDU transmit request of the Transport Layer to the FlexRay Interface and the corresponding confirmation of the FlexRay Interface on the receiver side (for FC or AF). Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeoutAs
elements.description: This attribute states the timeout between the PDU transmit request for the first PDU of the group used in the current connection of the Transport Layer to the FlexRay Interface and the corresponding confirmation of the FlexRay Interface (when having sent the last PDU of the group used in this connection) on the sender side (SF-x, FF-x, CF or FC (in case of Transmit Cancellation)). Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeoutBr
elements.description: This attribute specifies the timeout in seconds between the Pdu receive indication of the Transport Layer to the FlexRay Interface and the corresponding Pdu transmission of the FlexRay Interface on the receiver side.

elements.name: timeoutBs
elements.description: This parameter defines the timeout in seconds for waiting for an FC or AF on the sender side in a 1:1 connection.

elements.name: timeoutCr
elements.description: This parameter defines the timeout value in seconds for waiting for a CF or FF-x (in case of retry) after receiving the last CF or after sending an FC or AF on the receiver side. Specified in seconds.

elements.name: timeoutCs
elements.description: This attribute specifies the timeout in seconds to transmit the next ConsecutiveFrame NPdu or the last frame NPdu after receiving the flow control frame (CTS) from the sender side.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayTpEcu.name: FlexrayTpEcu
FlexrayTpEcu.description: ECU specific TP configuration parameters. Each TpEcu element has a reference to exactly one ECUInstance in the topology.

elements.name: cancellation
elements.description: With this switch Tx and Rx Cancellation can be turned on or off.

elements.name: cycleTimeMainFunction
elements.description: The period between successive calls to the Main Function of the AUTOSAR TP. Specified in seconds.

elements.name: ecuInstanceRef
elements.description: Connection to the ECUInstance in the Topology

elements.name: fullDuplexEnabled
elements.description: The full duplex mechanisms is enabled if this attribute is set to true. Otherwise half duplex is enabled.

elements.name: transmitCancellation
elements.description:
This attribute states whether Transmit Cancellation is supported on this ECU.

Please note that this attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayTpNode.name: FlexrayTpNode
FlexrayTpNode.description: TP Node (Sender or Receiver) provides the TP Address and the connection to the Topology description.

elements.name: connectorRefs
elements.description:
Asscociation  to one or more physical connectors (max number of connectors for FlexRay: 2).

In a System Description this reference is mandatory. In an ECU Extract this reference is optional (references to ECUs that are not part of the ECU Extract shall be avoided).

elements.name: tpAddressRef
elements.description: Reference to the TP Address that is used by the TpNode. This reference is optional in case that the multicast TP Address is used (reference from TpConnection).

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FlexrayTpPduPool.name: FlexrayTpPduPool
FlexrayTpPduPool.description: FlexrayTpPduPool is a set of N-PDUs which are defined for FrTp sending or receiving purpose.

elements.name: nPduRefs
elements.description: Reference to NPdus that are part of the PduPool.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FloatValueVariationPoint.name: FloatValueVariationPoint
FloatValueVariationPoint.description:
This class represents an attribute value variation point for Float attributes.

Note that this class might be used in the extended meta-model only

ForbiddenSignalPath.name: ForbiddenSignalPath
ForbiddenSignalPath.description: The ForbiddenSignalPath describes the physical channels which an element must not take in the topology. Such a signal path can be a constraint for the communication matrix,  because such a path has an effect on the frame generation and the frame path.

elements.name: operations
elements.description: Reference to the operation arguments of one operation which must not take the predefined way in the topology.

elements.name: physicalChannelRefs
elements.description: The SwcToSwcSignal must not be transmitted on one of these physical channels.

elements.name: signals
elements.description: The data element which must not take the predefined way in the topology.

ForeignModelReference.name: ForeignModelReference
ForeignModelReference.description: This meta-class represents the ability to express a late binding reference to a foreign model element. The foreign model element can be from every model. Even if it is modeled according to the association representation, it is not limited to refer to AUTOSAR model elements.

elements.name: ref
elements.description: This is the full qualified name of the model element

FormulaExpression.name: FormulaExpression
FormulaExpression.description: This class represents the syntax of the formula language. The class is modeled as an abstract class in order to be specialized into particular use cases. For each use case the referable objects might be specified in the specialization.

Frame.name: Frame
Frame.description: Data frame which is sent over a communication medium. This element describes the pure Layout of a frame sent on a channel.

elements.name: frameLength
elements.description:
The used length (in bytes)  of the referencing frame. Should not be confused with a static byte length reserved for each frame by some platforms (e.g. FlexRay). 

The frameLength of zero bytes is allowed.

elements.name: pduToFrameMappings
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

FrameMapping.name: FrameMapping
FrameMapping.description:
The entire source frame is mapped as it is onto the target frame (what in general is only possible inside of a common platform). In this case source and target frame should be the identical object.

Each pair consists in a SOURCE and a TARGET referencing to a FrameTriggering.

The Frame Mapping is not supported by the Autosar BSW. The existence is optional and has been incorporated into the System Template mainly for compatibility in order to allow interchange between FIBEX and AUTOSAR descriptions.

elements.name: introduction
elements.description: This represents introductory documentation about the frame mapping.

elements.name: sourceFrameRef
elements.description: Source destination of the referencing mapping.

elements.name: targetFrameRef
elements.description: Target destination of the referencing mapping.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

FramePid.name: FramePid
FramePid.description: Frame_PIDs that are included in the request. The "pid" attribute describes the value and the "index" attribute the position of the frame_PID in the request.

elements.name: index
elements.description: This attribute is used to order the frame_PIDs. The values of index shall be unique within one AssignFrameIdRange.

elements.name: pid
elements.description: Frame_PID value.

FramePort.name: FramePort
FramePort.description: Connectors reception or send port on the referenced channel referenced by a FrameTriggering.

FrameTriggering.name: FrameTriggering
FrameTriggering.description:
The FrameTriggering describes the instance of a frame sent on a channel and defines the manner of triggering (timing information) and identification of a frame on the channel, on which it is sent.

For the same frame, if FrameTriggerings exist on more than one channel of the same cluster the fan-out/in is handled by the Bus interface.

elements.name: framePortRefs
elements.description:
References to the FramePort on every ECU of the system which sends and/or
receives the frame.

References for both the sender and the receiver side shall be included when the system is completely defined.

elements.name: frameRef
elements.description: One frame can be triggered several times, e.g. on different channels. If a frame has no frame triggering, it won't be sent at all. A frame triggering has assigned exactly one frame, which it triggers.

IPduTiming.name: IPduTiming
IPduTiming.description:
AUTOSAR COM provides the possibility to define two different TRANSMISSION MODES for each IPdu.

The Transmission Mode of an IPdu that is valid at a specific point in time is selected using the values of the signals that are mapped to this IPdu. For each IPdu a Transmission Mode Selector is defined. The Transmission Mode Selector is calculated by evaluating the conditions for a subset of signals  (class TransmissionModeCondition in the System Template).

The Transmission Mode Selector is defined to be true, if at least one Condition evaluates to true and is defined to be false, if all Conditions evaluate to false.

elements.name: minimumDelay
elements.description: Minimum Delay in seconds between successive transmissions of this I-PDU, independent of the Transmission Mode.

elements.name: transmissionModeDeclaration
elements.description:
AUTOSAR COM allows configuring statically two different transmission modes for each
I-PDU (True and False). The Transmission Mode Selector evaluates the conditions for a subset of signals and decides the transmission mode. It is possible to switch between the transmission modes during runtime.

ISignal.name: ISignal
ISignal.description:
Signal of the Interaction Layer. The RTE supports a "signal fan-out" where the same System Signal is sent in different SignalIPdus to multiple receivers. 

To support the RTE "signal fan-out" each SignalIPdu  contains ISignals. If the same System Signal is to be mapped into several SignalIPdus there is one ISignal needed for each ISignalToIPduMapping. 

ISignals describe the Interface between the Precompile configured RTE and the potentially Postbuild configured Com Stack (see ECUC Parameter Mapping). 

In case of the SystemSignalGroup an ISignal must be created for each SystemSignal contained in the SystemSignalGroup.

elements.name: dataTransformations
elements.description: This property was modified due to atpVariation (DirectedAssociationPattern).

elements.name: dataTypePolicy
elements.description:
With the aggregation of SwDataDefProps an ISignal specifies how it is represented on the network. This representation follows a particular policy. Note that this causes some redundancy which is intended and can be used to support flexible development methodology as well as subsequent integrity checks. 

If the policy "networkRepresentationFromComSpec" is chosen the network representation from the ComSpec that is aggregated by the PortPrototype shall be used. 
If the "override" policy is chosen the requirements specified in the PortInterface and in the ComSpec are not fulfilled by the networkRepresentationProps. 
In case the System Description doesn't use a complete Software Component Description (VFB View) the "legacy" policy can be chosen.

elements.name: iSignalProps
elements.description: Additional optional ISignal properties that may be stored in different files.

elements.name: initValue
elements.description:
Optional definition of a ISignal's initValue in case the System Description doesn't use a complete Software Component Description (VFB View). This supports the inclusion of legacy system signals. 

This value can be used to configure the Signal's "InitValue". 

If a full DataMapping exist for the SystemSignal this information may be available from a configured SenderComSpec and ReceiverComSpec. 
In this case the initvalues in SenderComSpec and/or ReceiverComSpec override this optional value specification. Further restrictions apply from the RTE specification.

elements.name: length
elements.description:
Size of the signal in bits. The size needs to be derived from the mapped VariableDataPrototype according to the mapping of primitive DataTypes to BaseTypes as used in the RTE.
Indicates maximum size for dynamic length signals. 

The ISignal length of zero bits is allowed.

elements.name: networkRepresentationProps
elements.description:
Specification of the actual network representation. The usage of SwDataDefProps for this purpose is restricted to the attributes compuMethod and baseType. The optional baseType attributes "memAllignment" and "byteOrder" shall not be used. 

The attribute "dataTypePolicy" in the SystemTemplate element defines whether this network representation shall be ignored and the information shall be taken over from  the network representation of the ComSpec. 

If "override" is chosen by the system integrator the network representation can violate against the requirements defined in the PortInterface and in the network representation of the ComSpec. 

In case that the System Description doesn't use a complete Software Component Description (VFB View) this element is used to configure "ComSignalDataInvalidValue" and the Data Semantics.

The ISignal specific configuration properties for each transformer are defined in the TransformationISignalProps class. The transformer configuration properties that are common for all ISignals are described in the TransformationTechnology class.

ISignalGroup.name: ISignalGroup
ISignalGroup.description:
SignalGroup of the Interaction Layer. The RTE supports a "signal fan-out" where the same System Signal Group is sent in different SignalIPdus to multiple receivers.   

An ISignalGroup refers to a set of ISignals that shall always be kept together. A ISignalGroup represents a COM Signal Group.  

Therefore it is recommended to put the ISignalGroup in the same Package as ISignals (see atp.recommendedPackage)
