elements.name: pduCounterStartPosition
elements.description: Position of PduCounter expressed in bits. Note that PduCounter is not allowed to cross a byte border.

elements.name: pduCounterThreshold
elements.description: Threshold value of IPduCounter algorithm. See AUTOSAR COM Spec for more details.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SignalIPduReplication.name: SignalIPduReplication
SignalIPduReplication.description: PduReplication is a form of redundancy where the data content of one ISignalIPdu (source) is transmitted inside a set of replica ISignalIPdus. These ISignalIPdus (copies) have different Pdu IDs, identical PduCounters, identical data content and are transmitted with the same frequency.

elements.name: pduReplicationVoting
elements.description: Number of identical IPdus needed for successful voting (1-3).

elements.name: replicaPdusRefs
elements.description: Reference to replica Pdus of this IPdu.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SignalPathConstraint.name: SignalPathConstraint
SignalPathConstraint.description: Additional guidelines for the System Generator, which specific way a signal between two Software Components should take in the network without defining in which frame and with which timing it is transmitted.

elements.name: introduction
elements.description: This represents introductory documentation about the signal path constraint.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SimulatedExecutionTime.name: SimulatedExecutionTime
SimulatedExecutionTime.description: Specifies the ExecutionTime which has been gathered using simulation means.

elements.name: maximumExecutionTime
elements.description: The maximum simulated execution time.

elements.name: minimumExecutionTime
elements.description: The minimum simulated execution time.

elements.name: nominalExecutionTime
elements.description: The nominal simulated execution time.

SingleLanguageReferrable.name: SingleLanguageReferrable
SingleLanguageReferrable.description:
Instances of this class can be referred to by their identifier (while adhering to namespace borders). They also may have a longName but in one language only. 

Specializations of this class only occur as inline elements in one particular language. Therefore they aggregate

But they are not considered to contribute substantially to the overall structure of an AUTOSAR description. In particular it does not contain other Referrables.

elements.name: longName1
elements.description: This specifies the long name of the object. The role is longName1 for compatibilty to ASAM FSX

SingleLanguageUnitNames.name: SingleLanguageUnitNames
SingleLanguageUnitNames.description: This represents the ability to express a display name.

SoAdConfig.name: SoAdConfig
SoAdConfig.description: SoAd Configuration for one specific Physical Channel.

elements.name: connections
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: connectionBundles
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: logicAddresss
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: socketAddresss
elements.description: The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

SoAdRoutingGroup.name: SoAdRoutingGroup
SoAdRoutingGroup.description: Routing of Pdus in the SoAd can be activated or deactivated. The ShortName of this element shall contain the RoutingGroupId.

elements.name: eventGroupControlType
elements.description:
This attribute defines the type of a RoutingGroup. There are RoutingGroups that activate the data path for unicast or multicast events of an event group. And there are RoutingGroups that activate the data path for initial events that are triggered, namely events that are sent out on the server side after a client got subscribed.

Please note that this attribute is only valid for event communication (Sender Receiver communication) and shall be omitted in MethodActivationRoutingGroups.

SocketAddress.name: SocketAddress
SocketAddress.description: This meta-class represents the ability represent a socket address towards the rest of the meta-model. The actual semantics of the represented socket address, however, is contributed by aggregation of ApplicationEndpoint.

elements.name: applicationEndpoint
elements.description: Application addressing

elements.name: connectorRef
elements.description:
Association to a CommunicationConnector in the topology description. This reference shall be used if the SocketAddress describes an IP unicast address. 

In a System Description this reference is mandatory if an IP unicast address is described. In an ECU Extract this reference is optional (references to ECUs that are not part of the ECU Extract shall be avoided). Please note that in the SystemExtract or EcuExtract the type of the reference shall not change from unicast connectorRef to multicastConnectorRef.

elements.name: ipAddress
elements.description: This attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future. It is replaced by the aggregated NetworkEndpoint.

elements.name: multicastConnectorRefs
elements.description:
Association to a CommunicationConnector in the topology description. This reference shall be used if the SocketAddress describes an IP mutlicast address. This multicast SocketAddress shall contain references to all ECUs that want to receive the multicast messages. 

In a System Description this reference is mandatory if an IP multicast address is described. In an ECU Extract this reference is optional (references to ECUs that are not part of the ECU Extract shall be avoided). Please note that in the SystemExtract or EcuExtract the type of the reference shall not change from multicastConnectorRef to unicast connectorRef.

elements.name: portAddress
elements.description: This attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future. It is replaced by the aggregated ApplicationEndpoint.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SocketConnection.name: SocketConnection
SocketConnection.description: The SoAd serves as a (De)Multiplexer between different PDU sources and the TCP/IP stack.

elements.name: autosarConnector
elements.description: This attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

elements.name: clientIpAddrFromConnectionRequest
elements.description: If set to true the Server “learns“ the client IP address on connection request. This means that the statically configured IP Address of the related client shall be ignored. If set to false the Server only accepts statically configured IP address, e.g. 192.168.1.2. This means that the statically configured IP Address of the Client shall be used.

elements.name: clientPortFromConnectionRequest
elements.description: If set to true the Server “learns“ the client Port on connection request. This means that the statically configured Port of the related client shall be ignored. If set to false the Server only accepts statically configured Port. This means that the statically configured Port of the Client shall be used.

elements.name: clientPortRef
elements.description: Client Port for TCP/UDP connection in an abstract communication sense. The client is the major requester of the communication. Please note that the client may also produce data.

elements.name: doIpSourceAddressRef
elements.description: The logical DoIP address of the source entity. This optional reference shall only be used for DoIP (Diagnosis over IP).

elements.name: doIpTargetAddressRef
elements.description: The logical DoIP address of the target entity. This optional reference shall only be used for DoIP (Diagnosis over IP).

elements.name: ident
elements.description: This adds the ability to become referrable to SocketConnection.

elements.name: localPortRef
elements.description:
This reference is obsolete and will be removed in the future. The serverPort reference in SocketConnectionBundle shall be used instead.

Old description: Local Port for TCP/UDP connection.

elements.name: nPduRef
elements.description:
Reference to data packets that are transmitted over Ethernet. Each data packet can contain multiple IPdus. 

Please note that this reference is deprecated.

elements.name: pdus
elements.description: PDUs handed over by the PDU Router (Transmission over the Ethernet) or PDUs handed over by SoAd (Reception over Ethernet). Multiple IPdus can be transmitted over one socket connection.

elements.name: pduCollectionMaxBufferSize
elements.description: Defines the maximum buffer size in Byte which shall be filled before a socket with Pdu collection enabled shall be transmitted to the lower layer.

elements.name: pduCollectionTimeout
elements.description: Defines the time in seconds which shall pass before a socket with Pdu collection enabled shall be transmitted to the lower layer after the first Pdu has been put into the socket buffer.

elements.name: remotePortRef
elements.description:
This reference is obsolete and will be removed in the future. The clientPort reference shall be used instead.

Old description: Remote Port for TCP/UDP connection. May be different for each Frame or use the same remote port. In second case headerId attribute needs to be considered.

elements.name: runtimeIpAddressConfiguration
elements.description:
This attribute determines which protocol is used by the client to obtain the IP Address information. 
If this attribute is not set to none the value determines the service used by the client to obtain the IP Address information for the SocketConnection. If this attribute is set to none the client used the statically configured IP Address information.

elements.name: runtimePortConfiguration
elements.description: This attribute determines which protocol is used by the client to obtain the Port information. If this attribute is not set to none the value determines the service used by the client to obtain the Port information for the SocketConnection. If this attribute is set to none the client uses the statically configured Port information.

elements.name: shortLabel
elements.description: This attribute specifies an identifying shortName for the SocketConnection. It shall be unique within its context.

elements.name: socketProtocol
elements.description: This attribute is deprecated and will be removed in future.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SocketConnectionBundle.name: SocketConnectionBundle
SocketConnectionBundle.description: This elements groups SocketConnections, i.e. specifies socket connections belonging to the bundle and describes properties which are common for all socket connections in the bundle.

elements.name: bundledConnections
elements.description: Collection of SocketConnections in the connectionGroup.

elements.name: pdus
elements.description: With this aggregation SocketConnectionIpduIdentifier elements are assigned to all SocketConnections that are available in this SocketConnetionBundle.

elements.name: serverPortRef
elements.description: Server Port for TCP/UDP connection in an abstract communication sense. The server is the major provider of the communication. Please note that the server may also consume data.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SocketConnectionIpduIdentifier.name: SocketConnectionIpduIdentifier
SocketConnectionIpduIdentifier.description: An Identifier is required in case of one port per ECU communication where multiple Pdus are transmitted over the same connection. If only one IPdu is transmitted over the connetion this attribute can be ignored.

elements.name: headerId
elements.description: If multiple Pdus are transmitted over the same connection this headerId can be used to distinguish between the different Pdus.

elements.name: pduCollectionPduTimeout
elements.description: Defines the timeout in seconds the PDU collection shall be transmitted at the latest after this PDU has been put into the buffer.

elements.name: pduCollectionTrigger
elements.description: Defines whether the referenced Pdu contributes to the triggering of the socket transmission if Pdu collection is enabled for this socket.

elements.name: pduRef
elements.description:
This reference is deprecated and will be removed in future. 

Old description: Reference to an IPdu that is mapped to a socket connection.

elements.name: pduTriggeringRef
elements.description: Reference to a Pdu that is mapped to a socket connection.

elements.name: routingGroupRefs
elements.description: Reference to RoutingGroups that can be enabled or disabled.

SoftwareContext.name: SoftwareContext
SoftwareContext.description: Specifies the context of the software for this resource consumption.

elements.name: input
elements.description: Specifies the input vector which is used to provide the ExecutionTime.

elements.name: state
elements.description: Specifies the state the software is in when the ExecutionTime is provided.

SporadicEventTriggering.name: SporadicEventTriggering
SporadicEventTriggering.description: The SporadicEventTriggering describes the behavior of an event which occurs occasionally or singly.

elements.name: minimumInterArrivalTime
elements.description: The minimum time distance between two consecutive occurrences of the associated event.

elements.name: maximumInterArrivalTime
elements.description: The maximum time distance between two consecutive occurrences of the associated event.

elements.name: jitter
elements.description:
The maximum jitter of the sporadic event occurrence.

Jitter=max |nthPeriod - standardPeriod|

elements.name: period
elements.description: The period of the event occurrence.

StackUsage.name: StackUsage
StackUsage.description: Describes the stack memory usage of a software.

elements.name: executableEntityRef
elements.description: The executable entity for which this stack usage is described.

elements.name: hardwareConfiguration
elements.description: Contains information about the hardware context this stack usage is describing.

elements.name: hwElementRef
elements.description: Specifies for which hardware element (e.g. ECU) this stack usage is given.

elements.name: softwareContext
elements.description: Contains details about the software context this stack usage is provided for.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

StaticPart.name: StaticPart
StaticPart.description: Some parts/signals of the I-PDU may be the same regardless of the selector field. Such a part is called static part. The static part is optional.

elements.name: iPduRef
elements.description: Reference to a Com IPdu which is routed to the IPduM module and is combined to a multiplexedPdu.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

Std.name: Std
Std.description: This represents a reference to external standards.

elements.name: subtitle
elements.description: This represents the subtitle of the standard.

elements.name: state
elements.description: This represents  version and state of a standard. Kept as a string.

elements.name: date
elements.description: This element specifies the release date of the external standard if applicable.

elements.name: url
elements.description: This represents the URL of the standard.

elements.name: position
elements.description: This represents the reference to the relevant positions of a standard. Kept as a string.

StructuredReq.name: StructuredReq
StructuredReq.description:
This represents a structured requirement. This is intended for a case where specific requirements for features are collected.

Note that this can be rendered as a labeled list.

elements.name: date
elements.description: This represents the date when the requirement was initiated.

elements.name: issuedBy
elements.description: This represents the person, organization or authority which issued the requirement.

elements.name: type
elements.description: This attribute allows to denote the type of requirement to denote for example is it an "enhancement", "new feature" etc.

elements.name: importance
elements.description: This allows to represent the importance of the requirement.

elements.name: description
elements.description: Ths represents the general description of the requirement.

elements.name: rationale
elements.description: This represents the rationale of the requirement.

elements.name: dependencies
elements.description: This represents an informal specifiaction of dependencies. Note that upstream tracing should be formalized in the property trace provided by the superclass Traceable.

elements.name: useCase
elements.description: This describes the relevant use cases. Note that formal references to use cases should be done in the trace relation.

elements.name: conflicts
elements.description: This represents an informal specification of conflicts.

elements.name: supportingMaterial
elements.description: This represents an informal specifiaction of the supporting material.

elements.name: remark
elements.description: This represents an informal remark. Note that this is not modeled as annotation, since these remark is still essential part of the requirement.

elements.name: testedItemRefs
elements.description: This assocation represents the ability to trace on the same specification level. This supports for example the of acceptance tests.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SubElementMapping.name: SubElementMapping
SubElementMapping.description: This meta-class allows for the definition of mappings of elements of a composite data type.

elements.name: firstElements
elements.description:
This represents the first element referenced in the scope of the mapping.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: secondElements
elements.description:
This represents the second element referenced in the scope of the mapping.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: textTableMappings
elements.description: This allows for the text-table translation of individual elements of a composite data type.

SubElementRef.name: SubElementRef
SubElementRef.description: This meta-class provides the ability to reference elements of composite data type.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SupervisedEntityNeeds.name: SupervisedEntityNeeds
SupervisedEntityNeeds.description: Specifies the abstract needs on the configuration of the Watchdog Manager for one specific Supervised Entity.

elements.name: activateAtStart
elements.description: True/false: supervision activation status of SupervisedEntity shall be enabled/disabled at start.

elements.name: enableDeactivation
elements.description:
True: software-component shall be allowed to deactivate supervision of this SupervisedEntity
false:  software-component shall be not allowed to deactivate supervision of this SupervisedEntity

elements.name: expectedAliveCycle
elements.description: Expected cycle time of alive trigger of this SupervisedEntity (in seconds).

elements.name: maxAliveCycle
elements.description: Maximum cycle time of alive trigger of this SupervisedEntity (in seconds).

elements.name: minAliveCycle
elements.description: Minimum cycle time of alive trigger of this SupervisedEntity (in seconds).

elements.name: toleratedFailedCycles
elements.description:
Number of consecutive failed alive cycles for this SupervisedEntity which shall be tolerated until the supervision status of the SupervisedEntity is set to WDGM_ALIVE_EXPIRED (see SWS WdgM for more details). 

Note that this value has to be recalculated with respect to the WdgM's own cycle time for ECU configuration.

SwAddrMethod.name: SwAddrMethod
SwAddrMethod.description: Used to assign a common addressing method, e.g. common memory section, to data or code objects. These objects could actually live in different modules or components.

elements.name: memoryAllocationKeywordPolicy
elements.description: Enumeration to specify the name pattern of the Memory Allocation Keyword.

elements.name: options
elements.description:
This attribute introduces the ability to specify further intended properties of the MemorySection in with the related objects shall be placed. 

These properties are handled as to be selected. The intended options are mentioned in the list. 

In the Memory Mapping configuration, this option list is used to determine an appropriate MemMapAddressingModeSet.

elements.name: sectionInitializationPolicy
elements.description:
Specifies the expected initialization of the variables (inclusive those which are implementing VariableDataPrototypes). Therefore this is an implementation constraint for initialization code of BSW modules (especially RTE) as well as the start-up code which initializes the memory segment to which the AutosarDataPrototypes referring to the SwAddrMethod's are later on mapped.

If the attribute is not defined it has the identical semantic as the attribute value "INIT"

elements.name: sectionType
elements.description: Defines the type of memory sections which can be associated with this addresssing method.

SwAxisCont.name: SwAxisCont
SwAxisCont.description:
This represents the values for the axis of a compound primitive (curve, map).

For standard and fix axes,  SwAxisCont contains the values of the axis directly. 

The axis values of SwAxisCont with the category CURVE_AXIS, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS are for display only. For editing and processing, only the values in the related GroupAxis are binding.

elements.name: category
elements.description:
This category specifies the particular axis types: 

* FIX_AXIS 
* STD_AXIS 
* COM_AXIS 
* CURVE_AXIS  (swArraysize necessary) 
* RES_AXIS  (swArraysize necessary)

elements.name: unitRef
elements.description: This represents the physical unit of the provided values.

elements.name: unitDisplayName
elements.description: This represents the display name which is used for the physical unit of the axis.

elements.name: swAxisIndex
elements.description:
This property allows to explicitly assign the axis contents to a particular axis. It is specified by numbers where 1 corresponds to the x-axis.
It is also possible to derive the axis association from the sequence of the parent.

elements.name: swArraysize
elements.description:
For multidimensional compound primitivies (curve, map ...) it is necessary to know the dimensions.They are specified using swArraySize.

* RES_AXIS
* CURVE_AXIS

elements.name: swValuesPhys
elements.description: swValuesPhys represents the values in the physical domain.

SwAxisGeneric.name: SwAxisGeneric
SwAxisGeneric.description:
This meta-class defines a generic axis. In a generic axis the axispoints points are calculated in the ECU. 

The ECU is equipped with a fixed calculation algorithm. Parameters for the algorithm can be stored in the data component of the ECU. Therefore these parameters are specified in the data declaration, not in the calibration data.

elements.name: swAxisTypeRef
elements.description: Associated axis calculation strategy.

elements.name: swNumberOfAxisPoints
elements.description:
The number of base points to be calculated for this axis. This element exists to enable the number of axis points to be stored explicitly, although it could also be described as swGenericAxisParam.

This attribute has been deprecated, note that the value of SwAxisIndividual.swMaxAxisPoints shall be taken instead.

In case of a generated axis, the number of axis points to be  generated shall be taken from SwAxisIndividual.swMaxAxisPoints.

elements.name: swGenericAxisParams
elements.description: Specific parameter of a generic axis.

SwAxisGrouped.name: SwAxisGrouped
SwAxisGrouped.description: An SwAxisGrouped is an axis which is shared between multiple calibration parameters.

elements.name: sharedAxisTypeRef
elements.description: This is the datatype of the calibration parameter providing the shared axis.

elements.name: swAxisIndex
elements.description:
Describes which axis of the referenced calibration parameter provides the values for the group axis.
The index satisfies the following convention:

* 0 = value axis. in this case, the interpolation result of the referenced parameter is used as a base point index. This means that the A2L keyword CURVE_AXIS_REF can be supported.
* The index should only be specified if the parameter under swCalprm contains more than one axis. It is standard practice for the axis index of parameters with more than one axis, to be set to 1, if data has not been assigned to swAxisIndex.

elements.name: arParameter
elements.description: This represents a Parameter within AUTOSAR. Note that the Datatype of the referenced ParameterDataPrototype shall be an ApplicationDataType of category VALUE.

elements.name: mcDataInstanceRef
elements.description:
This reference is used in the McSupport file to express the final instance of group axis etc. It is not allowed to use this outside of an McDataInstance.

The referenced mcDataInstance shall be originated from a ParameterDataPrototype.

SwAxisIndividual.name: SwAxisIndividual
SwAxisIndividual.description: This meta-class describes an axis integrated into a parameter (field etc.). The integration makes this individual to each parameter. The so-called grouped axis represents the counterpart to this. It is conceived as an independent parameter (see class SwAxisGrouped).

elements.name: inputVariableTypeRef
elements.description: This is the datatype of the input value for the axis. This allows to define e.g. a type of curve, where the input value is finalized at the access point.

elements.name: swVariableRefs
elements.description:
Refers to input variables of the axis. It is possible to specify more than one variable. Here the following is valid:

* The variable with the highest priority shall be given first. It is used in the generation of the code and is also displayed first in the application system.

* All variables referenced shall be of the same physical nature. This is usually detected in that the conversion formulae affected refer back to the same SI-units.
In AUTOSAR this ensured by the constraint, that the referenced input variables shall use a type compatible to "inputVariableType".

* This multiple referencing allows a base point distribution for more than one input variable to be used. One example of this are the temperature curves which can depend both on the induction air temperature and the engine temperature.

These variables can be displayed simultaneously by MCD systems (adjustment systems), enabling operating points to be shown in the curves.

elements.name: compuMethodRef
elements.description: This is the compuMethod which is expected for the axis. It is used in early stages if the particular input-value is not yet available.

elements.name: unitRef
elements.description: This represents the physical unit of the input value of the axis. It is provided to support the case that the particular input variable is not yet known.

elements.name: swMaxAxisPoints
elements.description: Maximum number of base points contained in the axis of a map or curve.

elements.name: swMinAxisPoints
elements.description: Minimum number of base points contained in the axis of a map or curve.

elements.name: dataConstrRef
elements.description: Refers to constraints, e.g. for plausibility checks.

elements.name: swAxisGeneric
elements.description: this specifies the properties of a generic axis if applicable.

SwAxisType.name: SwAxisType
SwAxisType.description:
This meta-class represents a specific axis calculation strategy. No formal specification is given, due to the fact that it is possible to use arbitrary algorithms for calculating axis-points. 

Instead, the algorithm is described verbally but the parameters are specified formally with respect to their names and constraints. As a result, SwAxisType mainly reserves appropriate keywords.

elements.name: swGenericAxisDesc
elements.description: Associated axis description in textual form .

elements.name: swGenericAxisParamTypes
elements.description: Parameters for this calcultaion algorithm.

SwBaseType.name: SwBaseType
SwBaseType.description: This meta-class represents a base type used within ECU software.

SwBitRepresentation.name: SwBitRepresentation
SwBitRepresentation.description: Description of the structure of a bit variable: Comprises of the bitPosition in a memory object (e.g. swHostVariable, which stands parallel to swBitRepresentation) and the numberOfBits . In this way, interrelated memory areas can be described. Non-related memory areas are not supported.

elements.name: bitPosition
elements.description: If the "bit data object" is hosted within another data object (e.g. if the memory can be accessed via byte as well as bit address), this attribute specifies the position of the data object. The count starts at zero (0).

elements.name: numberOfBits
elements.description: Number of bits allocated by a "bit data object" within its host data object.

SwCalprmAxis.name: SwCalprmAxis
SwCalprmAxis.description: This element specifies an individual input parameter axis (abscissa).

elements.name: swAxisIndex
elements.description:
This attribute specifies which axis is specified by the containing SwCalprmAxis.

For example in a curve this is usually "1". In a map this is "1" or "2".

elements.name: category
elements.description: This property specifies the category of a particular axis.

elements.name: swCalibrationAccess
elements.description: Describes the applicability of parameters and variables.

elements.name: displayFormat
elements.description: This property specifies how the axis values shall be displayed e.g. in documents or in measurement and calibration tools.

elements.name: baseTypeRef
elements.description: The SwBaseType to be used for the axis. Note that this is not applicable for ApplicationDataTypes. The value shall be ignored.

SwCalprmAxisSet.name: SwCalprmAxisSet
SwCalprmAxisSet.description: This element specifies the input parameter axes (abscissas) of parameters (and variables, if these are used adaptively).

elements.name: swCalprmAxis
elements.description: One axis belonging to this SwCalprmAxisSet

SwCalprmAxisTypeProps.name: SwCalprmAxisTypeProps
SwCalprmAxisTypeProps.description: Base class for the type of the calibration axis. This provides the particular model of the specialization. If the specialization would be the directly from SwCalPrmAxis, the sequence of common properties and the specializes ones would be different.

SwCalprmRefProxy.name: SwCalprmRefProxy
SwCalprmRefProxy.description: Wrapper class for different kinds of references to a calibration parameter.

elements.name: arParameter
elements.description: This represents a Parameter within AUTOSAR. Note that the Datatype of the referenced ParameterDataPrototype shall be an ApplicationDataType of category VALUE.

elements.name: mcDataInstanceRef
elements.description:
This reference is used in the McSupport file to express the final instance of group axis etc. It is not allowed to use this outside of an McDataInstance.

The referenced mcDataInstance shall be originated from a ParameterDataPrototype.

SwComponentDocumentation.name: SwComponentDocumentation
SwComponentDocumentation.description: This class specifies the ability to write dedicated documentation to a component type according to ASAM FSX.

elements.name: swFeatureDef
elements.description: This element contains the definition of the physical functionality of this software component. This definition is more or less formal and is intended to be delivered from modeling tools.

elements.name: swFeatureDesc
elements.description: This element contains the textual description of the software functionality of this software component. Expert should write this description.

elements.name: swTestDesc
elements.description: This element contains suggestions and hints for the test of the software functionality of this software component.

elements.name: swCalibrationNotes
elements.description: This element contains calibration instructions and hints for a calibration engineer.

elements.name: swMaintenanceNotes
elements.description: This element contains information regarding the software maintenance of the component.

elements.name: swDiagnosticsNotes
elements.description: This element contains general information about diagnostics issues within the component.

elements.name: swCarbDoc
elements.description: This element records the documentation requested by CARB.

elements.name: chapter
elements.description:
These chapters provide additional information about the software component that do not fit in the other chapters.

Note that this is subject to variation because Chapter aggregations in the role chapter are variant within the documentation in general.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwComponentPrototype.name: SwComponentPrototype
SwComponentPrototype.description: Role of a software component within a composition.

elements.name: typeTref
elements.description: Type of the instance.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwComponentType.name: SwComponentType
SwComponentType.description: Base class for AUTOSAR software components.

elements.name: swComponentDocumentations
elements.description:
This adds a documentation to the SwComponentType.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: consistencyNeedss
elements.description:
This represents the colelction of ConsistencyNeeds owned by the enclosing SwComponentType.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: ports
elements.description:
The ports through which this component can communicate.
The aggregation of PortPrototype is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of PortPrototypes.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: portGroups
elements.description:
A port group being part of this component.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: unitGroupRefs
elements.description: This allows for the specification of which UnitGroups are relevant in the context of referencing SwComponentType.

SwConnector.name: SwConnector
SwConnector.description: The base class for connectors between ports. Connectors have to be identifiable to allow references from the system constraint template.

elements.name: mappingRef
elements.description: Reference to a PortInterfaceMapping specifying the mapping of unequal named PortInterface elements of the two different PortInterfaces typing the two PortPrototypes which are referenced by the ConnectorPrototype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwDataDefProps.name: SwDataDefProps
SwDataDefProps.description:
This class is a collection of properties relevant for data objects under various aspects. One could consider this class as a "pattern of inheritance by aggregation". The properties can be applied to all objects of all classes in which SwDataDefProps is aggregated.

Note that not all of the attributes or associated elements are useful all of the time. Hence, the process definition (e.g. expressed with an OCL or a Document Control Instance MSR-DCI) has the task of implementing limitations.

SwDataDefProps covers various aspects:

* Structure of the data element for calibration use cases: is it a single value, a curve, or a map, but also the recordLayouts which specify how such elements are mapped/converted to the DataTypes in the programming language (or in AUTOSAR). This is mainly expressed by properties like swRecordLayout and swCalprmAxisSet 

* Implementation aspects, mainly expressed by swImplPolicy, swVariableAccessImplPolicy, swAddrMethod, swPointerTagetProps, baseType, implementationDataType and additionalNativeTypeQualifier

* Access policy for the MCD system, mainly expressed by swCalibrationAccess 

* Semantics of the data element, mainly expressed by compuMethod and/or unit, dataConstr, invalidValue

* Code generation policy provided by swRecordLayout

elements.name: swDataDefPropsVariants
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwDataDefPropsConditional.name: SwDataDefPropsConditional
SwDataDefPropsConditional.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwDataDefPropsContent.name: SwDataDefPropsContent
SwDataDefPropsContent.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

elements.name: stepSize
elements.description: This attribute can be used to define a value which is added to or subtracted from the value of a DataPrototype when using up/down keys while calibrating.

elements.name: annotations
elements.description: This aggregation allows to add annotations (yellow pads ...) related to the current data object.

elements.name: swAddrMethodRef
elements.description: Addressing method related to this data object. Via an association to the same SwAddrMethod it can be specified that several DataPrototypes shall be located in the same memory without already specifying the memory section itself.

elements.name: swAlignment
elements.description: The attribute describes the intended alignment of the DataPrototype. If the attribute is not defined the alignment is determined by the swBaseType size and the memoryAllocationKeywordPolicy of the referenced SwAddrMethod.

elements.name: baseTypeRef
elements.description: Base type associated with the containing data object.

elements.name: swBitRepresentation
elements.description: Description of the binary representation in case of a bit variable.

elements.name: swCalibrationAccess
elements.description: Specifies the read or write access by MCD tools for this data object.

elements.name: swValueBlockSize
elements.description: This represents the size of a Value Block

elements.name: swCalprmAxisSet
elements.description: This specifies the properties of the axes in case of a curve or map etc. This is mainly applicable to calibration parameters.

elements.name: swTextProps
elements.description: the specific properties if the data object is a text object.

elements.name: swComparisonVariables
elements.description: Variables used for comparison in an MCD process.

elements.name: compuMethodRef
elements.description: Computation method associated with the semantics of this data object.

elements.name: dataConstrRef
elements.description: Data constraint for this data object.

elements.name: swDataDependency
elements.description: Describes how the value of the data object has to be calculated from the value of another data object (by the MCD system).

elements.name: displayFormat
elements.description: This property describes how a number is to be rendered e.g. in documents or in a measurement and calibration system.

elements.name: implementationDataTypeRef
elements.description:
This association denotes the ImplementationDataType of a data declaration via its aggregated SwDataDefProps. It is used whenever a data declaration is not directly referring to a base type. Especially

* redefinition of an ImplementationDataType via a "typedef" to another ImplementationDatatype
* the target type of a pointer (see SwPointerTargetProps), if it does not refer to a base type directly
* the data type of an array or record element within an ImplementationDataType, if it does not refer to a base type directly
* the data type of an SwServiceArg, if it does not refer to a base type directly

elements.name: swHostVariable
elements.description: Contains a reference to a variable which serves as a host-variable for a bit variable. Only applicable to bit objects.

elements.name: swImplPolicy
elements.description: Implementation policy for this data object.

elements.name: additionalNativeTypeQualifier
elements.description: This attribute is used to declare native qualifiers of the programming language which can neither be deduced from the baseType (e.g. because the data object describes a pointer) nor from other more abstract attributes. Examples are qualifiers like "volatile", "strict" or "enum" of the C-language. All such declarations have to be put into one string.

elements.name: swIntendedResolution
elements.description:
The purpose of this element is to describe the requested quantization of data objects early on in the design process. 

The resolution ultimately occurs via the conversion formula present (compuMethod), which specifies the transition from the physical world to the standardized world (and vice-versa) (here, "the slope per bit" is present implicitly in the conversion formula). 

In the case of a development phase without a fixed conversion formula, a pre-specification can occur through swIntendedResolution.

The resolution is specified in the physical domain according to the property "unit".

elements.name: swInterpolationMethod
elements.description: This is a keyword identifying the mathematical method to be applied for interpolation. The keyword needs to be related to the interpolation routine which needs to be invoked.

elements.name: invalidValue
elements.description: Optional value to express invalidity of the actual data element.

elements.name: mcFunction
elements.description:
Specifies the name of a "Function" (in the sense of the MC system) to which this data object belongs. This corresponds to the Function in ASAM MCD 2MC /ASAP2 which defines the characteristic resp. which provides the measurement as output.

The function name is only used for support of MC systems. It can be predefined on the level of software component design. If it  is not  predefined, it could be filled out with a reasonable name, e.g. the component  prototype name, from the ECU extract. 

Note: This attribute is deprecated because an explicit model of MC functions can be set up by using the meta-class McFunction.

elements.name: swIsVirtual
elements.description: This element distinguishes virtual objects. Virtual objects do not appear in the memory, their derivation is much more dependent on other objects and hence they shall have a swDataDependency .

elements.name: swPointerTargetProps
elements.description: Specifies that the containing data object is a pointer to another data object.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutRef
elements.description: Record layout for this data object.

elements.name: swRefreshTiming
elements.description:
This element specifies the frequency in which the object involved shall be or is called or calculated.  This timing can be collected from the task in which write access processes to the variable run. But this cannot be done by the MCD system. 

So this attribute can be used in an early phase to express the desired refresh timing and later on to specify the real refresh timing.

elements.name: unitRef
elements.description: Physical unit associated with the semantics of this data object. This attribute applies if no compuMethod is specified. If both units (this as well as via compuMethod) are specified the units shall be compatible.

elements.name: valueAxisDataTypeRef
elements.description: The referenced ApplicationPrimitiveDataType represents the primitive data type of the value axis within a compound primitive (e.g. curve, map). It supersedes CompuMethod, Unit, and BaseType.

SwDataDependency.name: SwDataDependency
SwDataDependency.description:
This element describes the interdependencies of data objects, e.g. variables and parameters. 

Use cases:
* Calculate the value of a calibration parameter (by the MCD system) from the value(s) of other calibration parameters.
* Virtual data - that means the data object is not directly in the ecu and this property describes how the "virtual variable" can be computed from the real ones (by the MCD system).

elements.name: swDataDependencyFormula
elements.description: This element describes the formula with which the dependencies between the participating objects are defined.

elements.name: swDataDependencyArgs
elements.description: Specifies the arguments used in the data dependency. Note that this is 0..1 since the aggregated class is a container (atpMixed).

SwDataDependencyArgs.name: SwDataDependencyArgs
SwDataDependencyArgs.description: This element specifies the elements used in a SwDataDependency.

elements.name: arParameter
elements.description: This represents a Parameter within AUTOSAR. Note that the Datatype of the referenced ParameterDataPrototype shall be an ApplicationDataType of category VALUE.

elements.name: mcDataInstanceRef
elements.description:
This reference is used in the McSupport file to express the final instance of group axis etc. It is not allowed to use this outside of an McDataInstance.

The referenced mcDataInstance shall be originated from a ParameterDataPrototype.

elements.name: autosarVariable
elements.description: This represents the reference to a Variable in an Autosar system. Note that the target of the reference within AutosarVariableRef shall be typed by a  primitive data type

elements.name: mcDataInstanceVarRef
elements.description:
This reference is used in the McSupport file to express the final instance of input values etc. It is not allowed to use this outside of an McDataInstance.

The referenced mcDataInstance shall be originated from a VariableDataPrototype.

SwGenericAxisParam.name: SwGenericAxisParam
SwGenericAxisParam.description:
This meta-class describes a specific parameter of a generic axis. The name of the parameter is defined through a reference to a parameter type defined on a corresponding axis type.

The value of the parameter is given here in case that it is not changeable during calibration. Example is shift / offset in a fixed axis.

elements.name: swGenericAxisParamTypeRef
elements.description: Parameter type defined on a corresponding axis type. References can only be made to axis parameters types which are defined within the referenced axis type.

elements.name: vf
elements.description: This attribute represents the value of the generic axis parameter.

SwGenericAxisParamType.name: SwGenericAxisParamType
SwGenericAxisParamType.description:
This meta-class describes a generic axis parameter type, namely:

* Plausibility checks can be specified via dataConstr.

* Textual description (desc), as a formal description is not of any use, due to the large variety of possibilities.

* If this parameter contains structures, these can be simulated through the recursive use of SwGenericAxisParamTypes.

elements.name: dataConstrRef
elements.description: This refernce denoted data constraints applicable to the generic axis parameter.

SwPointerTargetProps.name: SwPointerTargetProps
SwPointerTargetProps.description:
This element defines, that the data object (which is specified by the aggregating element) contains a reference to another data object or to a function in the CPU code. This corresponds to a pointer in the C-language.

The attributes of this element describe the category and the detailed properties of the target which is either a data description or a function signature.

elements.name: targetCategory
elements.description:
This specifies the category of the target:

* In case of a data pointer, it shall specify the category of the referenced data.

* In case of a function pointer, it could be used to denote the category of the referenced BswModuleEntry. Since currently no categories for BswModuleEntry are defined it will be empty.

elements.name: swDataDefProps
elements.description: The properties of the target data type.

elements.name: functionPointerSignatureRef
elements.description: The referenced BswModuleEntry serves as the signature of a function pointer definition. Primary use case: function pointer passed as argument to other function.

SwRecordLayout.name: SwRecordLayout
SwRecordLayout.description: Defines how the data objects (variables, calibration parameters etc.) are to be stored in the ECU memory. As an example, this definition specifies the sequence of axis points in the ECU memory. Iterations through axis values are stored within the sub-elements swRecordLayoutGroup.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroup
elements.description: This is the top level record layout group.

SwRecordLayoutGroup.name: SwRecordLayoutGroup
SwRecordLayoutGroup.description: Specifies how a record layout is set up. Using SwRecordLayoutGroup it recursively models iterations through axis values. The subelement swRecordLayoutGroupContentType may reference other SwRecordLayouts, SwRecordLayoutVs and SwRecordLayoutGroups for the modeled record layout.

elements.name: shortLabel
elements.description: This attribute specifies a name which can be used e.g. when ECU code is generated from the record layout group.

elements.name: category
elements.description:
This attribute denotes the semantics in particular in terms of the corresponding A2L-Keyword. This is to support the mapping of the more general record layouts in AUTOSAR/MSR to the specific A2l keywords. 

It is possible to express the specific semantics of A2l recordlayout keywords in swRecordlayoutGroup but not always vice versa. Therefore the mapping is provided in this optional attribute.

elements.name: desc
elements.description: This aggregation allows a brief description about the particular record layout group which can help to identify the entry. In-depth documentation should be added  to the introduction of the surrounding record layout.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroupAxis
elements.description: This attribute specifies the iteration axis number for a SwRecordLayoutGroup. The current record layout group then refers exactly to the axis with this number. This means that the values are taken by iterating along the thus referenced axis.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroupIndex
elements.description: This attribute attributes a symbolic name to the iterator of the superimposed record layout group. This can be referenced as a loop index in contained SwRecordLayoutV elements.

elements.name: swGenericAxisParamTypeRef
elements.description:
This association allows to specify record layout groups to iterate over generic axis parameters. For example, if the generic axis parameter is an array, the record layout group will iterate over this array. 

Obviously, the axis referred to by swRecordLayoutGroupAxis shall be a generic axis in which the referenced SwGenericAxisType is aggregated.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroupFrom
elements.description:
This attribute specifies the iterator index for the point in the axis from which a record layout group is commenced. 

Negative values are also possible, i.e. the value -4 counts from the fourth value from the end. If this property is missing, the iteration starts with '1'.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroupTo
elements.description:
This attribute specifies the end point for the iteration. Negative values are also possible, i.e. the value -4 counts up to the fourth value from the end. If this property is not there, the iteration ends at "-1" which is the last element.

Note that depending on the arraySizeSemantics of SwTextProps the iteration ends at the value specified in swMaxTextSize.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroupStep
elements.description:
This attribute specifies the step width for the iterator index that is used for the current record layout group. 

Note that negative values are also possible, in case of the starting point is higher than the endpoint. If the property is missing, the step width is "1".

elements.name: swRecordLayoutComponent
elements.description:
This attribute is used to denote the component to which the group in question applies. Thus, the record layout supports structured objects. 

This secures independence from the sequence of components, because they can be referred to via name.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutRef
elements.description:
This association allows to support reusable "sub"-record layouts. In particluar, the contents of the referenced record layout shall be used as if the record layout group in the referenced record layout was aggregated in the current record layout group. 

So, semantically it would be equivalent to replace the particluar association with an aggregation of the  swRecordLayoutGroup of the referenced SwRecordLayout.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutV
elements.description: Particular Value specification for this record layout group.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroup
elements.description: This aggregation provides support for nested iterations. For example, if a map is to be handled, then we might have two nested SwRecordLayoutGroups, one for the x-axis and one for the y-axis. The inner iteration runs faster.

SwRecordLayoutGroupContent.name: SwRecordLayoutGroupContent
SwRecordLayoutGroupContent.description: This is the contents of a RecordLayout which is inserted for every iteration. Note that since this is atpMixed, multiple properties can be inserted for each iteration.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutRef
elements.description:
This association allows to support reusable "sub"-record layouts. In particluar, the contents of the referenced record layout shall be used as if the record layout group in the referenced record layout was aggregated in the current record layout group. 

So, semantically it would be equivalent to replace the particluar association with an aggregation of the  swRecordLayoutGroup of the referenced SwRecordLayout.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutV
elements.description: Particular Value specification for this record layout group.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutGroup
elements.description: This aggregation provides support for nested iterations. For example, if a map is to be handled, then we might have two nested SwRecordLayoutGroups, one for the x-axis and one for the y-axis. The inner iteration runs faster.

SwRecordLayoutV.name: SwRecordLayoutV
SwRecordLayoutV.description: This element specifies which values are stored for the current SwRecordLayoutGroup. If no baseType is present, the SwBaseType referenced initially in the parent SwRecordLayoutGroup is valid. The specification of swRecordLayoutVAxis gives the axis of the values which shall be stored in accordance with the current record layout SwRecordLayoutGroup. In swRecordLayoutVProp one can specify the information which shall be stored.

elements.name: shortLabel
elements.description: This attribute specifies a name which can be used e.g. when ECU code is generated from the record layout value.

elements.name: category
elements.description: This attribute denotes the semantics in particular in terms of the corresponding A2L-Keyword. This is to support the mapping of the more general record layouts in AUTOSAR/MSR to the specific A2l keywords. It is possible to express the specific semantics of A2l RecordLayout keywords in swRecordlayoutGroup but not always vice versa. Therefore the mapping is provided in this optional attribute.

elements.name: desc
elements.description: This aggregation allows for a brief description about the particular record layout value which can help to identify the entry. In-depth documentation should be added to the introduction of the surrounding record layout.

elements.name: baseTypeRef
elements.description: This association allows to refer to a base type in case a specific encoding is intended. If no base type is referred, the base type referenced initially in the corresponding DataPrototype is to be used.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutVAxis
elements.description:
This attribute gives the index of the axis of which values that are stored in the record. swRecordVIndex refers to the symbolic names of the iterators for which the axis value shall be stored in the record. 

In case of nested iterators (mainly for multidimensional objects) the iterator names are specified as whitespace-separated names. 

These symbolic names relate to swRecordLayoutGroupIndex. The iterators are processed from left to right in such a manner that they symbolize the loop index from the outside to the inside. 

It is considered an error if more components are specified than axes exist in the related ApplicationDataType.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutVProp
elements.description: This attribute describes the kind of values to be stored. More details see below. The standardized values foreseen for this attribute are defined in [TPS_SWCT_01489].

elements.name: swRecordLayoutVIndex
elements.description:
The symbolic value for iteration, or the symbolic values separated by whitespaces, refer to the symbolic values given in swRecordLayoutGroupIndex . 

The iterators are processed from left to right, in such a manner that they symbolize the loop index from the outside to the inside.

It is considered an error if the record layout is referenced by an entity which has less number of axes than index names referenced here.

elements.name: swGenericAxisParamTypeRef
elements.description: This association supports the case that a value from a generic axis definition shall be stored. This value is denoted by a particular generic axis parameter type.

elements.name: swRecordLayoutVFixValue
elements.description: This attribute specifies the filler character for the current record layout, in the form of hex digits. It is also used to specify the fix value for e.g. FIXRIGHTDIFF.

SwServiceArg.name: SwServiceArg
SwServiceArg.description:
Specifies the properties of a data object exchanged during the call of an SwService, e.g. an argument or a return value.

The SwServiceArg can also be used in the argument list of a C-macro. For this purpose the category shall be set to "MACRO". A reference to implementationDataType can optional be added if the actual argument has an implementationDataType.

elements.name: direction
elements.description:
Specifies the direction of the data transfer. The direction shall indicate the direction of the actual information that is being consumed by the caller and/or the callee, not the direction of formal arguments in C.

The attribute is optional for backwards compatibility reasons.
For example, if a pointer is used to pass a memory address for the expected result, the direction shall be "out".
If a pointer is used to pass a memory address with content to be read by the callee, its direction shall be "in".

elements.name: swArraysize
elements.description: This turns the argument of the service to an array.

elements.name: swDataDefProps
elements.description: Data properties of this SwServiceArg.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwSystemconst.name: SwSystemconst
SwSystemconst.description:
This element defines a system constant which serves an input to 
select a particular variation point. In particular a system constant serves as an operand of the binding function (swSyscond) in a Variation point.

Note that the binding process can only happen  if a value was assigned to to the referenced system constants.

elements.name: swDataDefProps
elements.description: This denotes the data defintion properties of the system constant. In particular it is the limits and - in case the system constant is an enumeration - the compu method.

SwSystemconstDependentFormula.name: SwSystemconstDependentFormula
SwSystemconstDependentFormula.description: This class represents an expression depending on system constants.

elements.name: syscStringRef
elements.description: syscString indicates that the referenced system constant shall be evaluated as a string according to [TPS_SWCT_01431].

elements.name: syscRef
elements.description: This refers to a system constant. The internal (coded) value of the system constant shall be used.

SwSystemconstValue.name: SwSystemconstValue
SwSystemconstValue.description: This meta-class assigns a particular value to a system constant.

elements.name: swSystemconstRef
elements.description: This is the system constant to which the value applies.

elements.name: value
elements.description:
This is the particular value of a system constant. It is specified as Numerical. Further restrictions may apply by the definition of the system constant.

The value attribute defines the internal value of the SwSystemconst as it is processed  in the Formula Language.

elements.name: annotations
elements.description: This provides the ability to add information why the value is set like it is.

SwSystemconstantValueSet.name: SwSystemconstantValueSet
SwSystemconstantValueSet.description: This meta-class represents the ability to specify a set of system constant values.

elements.name: swSystemconstantValues
elements.description: This is one particular value of a system constant.

SwTextProps.name: SwTextProps
SwTextProps.description: This meta-class expresses particular properties applicable to strings in variables or calibration parameters.

elements.name: arraySizeSemantics
elements.description:
This attribute controls the semantics of the arraysize for the array representing the string in an ImplementationDataType. 

It is there to support a safe conversion between ApplicationDatatype and ImplementationDatatype, even for variable length strings as required e.g. for Support of SAE J1939.

In conjunction with swFillCharacter, it provides the following options:

* FixedLengthString:  FixedSize - no fillcharacter
* TerminatedStringFixedLengthCommunication: FixedSize - with fillcharacter
* VariableLengthString: VariableSize - no fillcharacter
* TerminatedStringVariableLengthCommunication: VariableSize with fillcharacter

elements.name: swMaxTextSize
elements.description: Specifies the maximum text size in characters. Note the size in bytes depends on the encoding in the corresponding baseType.

elements.name: baseTypeRef
elements.description: This is the base type of one character in the string. In particular this baseType denotes the intended encoding of the characters in the string  on level of ApplicationDataType.

elements.name: swFillCharacter
elements.description:
Filler character for text parameter to pad up to the maximum length swMaxTextSize.

The value will be interpreted according to the encoding specified in the associated base type of the data object, e.g. 0x30 (hex) represents the ASCII character zero as filler character and 0 (dec) represents an end of string as filler character.

The usage of the fill character depends on the arraySizeSemantics.

SwValueCont.name: SwValueCont
SwValueCont.description: This metaclass represents the content of one particular SwInstance.

elements.name: unitRef
elements.description: This represents the physical unit of the provided values.

elements.name: unitDisplayName
elements.description: This specifies how the physical units of the current value set shall be displayed in documents or in user interfaces of tools.

elements.name: swArraysize
elements.description:
This attribute defines the size of each dimension for compound primitivies
CURVE, MAP, CUBOID, CUB_4, CUBE_5, COM_AXIS, RES_AXIS, CURVE_AXIS, VAL_BLK, STRING.

For each dimension one value has to be defined, e.g. one in case of COM_AXIS and two or more in case of MAP.

elements.name: swValuesPhys
elements.description: swValuesPhys represents the values in the physical domain.

SwValues.name: SwValues
SwValues.description:
This meta-class represents a list of values. These values can either be the input values of a curve (abscissa values) or the associated values (ordinate values). 

In case of multidimensional structures, the values are ordered such that the lowest index runs the fastest. In particular for maps and cuboids etc. the resulting long value list can be subsectioned using ValueGroup. But the processing needs to be done as if vg is not there.

Note that numerical values and textual values should not be mixed.

elements.name: vtf
elements.description:
Thias aggregation represents the ability to provide a value that is either numerical or text which existence is subject to variability.

From the formal point of view, the aggregation needs to have the multiplicity 1 because SwValues is modelled with stereotype <<atpMixed>>. Nevertheless, the existence of vtf is optional and subject to constraints.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was 1.

elements.name: vf
elements.description: This allows to specify the value as VariationPoint. It is distinguished to non variant for sake of compatibility to ASAM CDF 2.0.

elements.name: vt
elements.description: This represents the values of textual data elements (Strings). Note that vt uses the | to separate the values for the different bitfield masks in case that the semantics of the related DataPrototype is described by means of a BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE in the associated CompuMethod.

elements.name: v
elements.description: This is a non variant Value. It is provided for sake of Compatibility to ASAM CDF.

elements.name: vg
elements.description: This allows to have intersections in the values in order to support specific rendering (eg. using stylesheets). For tools it is important that the v values are always processed in the same (flattened) order and the tool is able to interpret it without respecting vg.

SwVariableRefProxy.name: SwVariableRefProxy
SwVariableRefProxy.description: Proxy class for several kinds of references to a variable.

elements.name: autosarVariable
elements.description: This represents the reference to a Variable in an Autosar system. Note that the target of the reference within AutosarVariableRef shall be typed by a  primitive data type

elements.name: mcDataInstanceVarRef
elements.description:
This reference is used in the McSupport file to express the final instance of input values etc. It is not allowed to use this outside of an McDataInstance.

The referenced mcDataInstance shall be originated from a VariableDataPrototype.

SwcBswMapping.name: SwcBswMapping
SwcBswMapping.description: Maps an SwcInternalBehavior to an BswInternalBehavior. This is required to coordinate the API generation and the scheduling for AUTOSAR Service Components, ECU Abstraction Components and Complex Driver Components by the RTE and the BSW scheduling mechanisms.

elements.name: bswBehaviorRef
elements.description: The mapped BswInternalBehavior

elements.name: runnableMappings
elements.description:
A mapping between a pair of SWC and BSW runnables.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: swcBehaviorRef
elements.description: The mapped SwcInternalBehavior.

elements.name: synchronizedModeGroups
elements.description:
A pair of SWC and BSW mode group prototypes to be synchronized by the scheduler.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: synchronizedTriggers
elements.description:
A pair of SWC and BSW Triggers to be synchronized by the scheduler.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

SwcBswRunnableMapping.name: SwcBswRunnableMapping
SwcBswRunnableMapping.description: Maps a BswModuleEntity to a RunnableEntity if it is implemented as part of a BSW module (in the case of an AUTOSAR Service, a Complex Driver or an ECU Abstraction). The mapping can be used by a tool to find relevant information on the behavior, e.g. whether the bswEntity shall be running in interrupt context.

elements.name: bswEntityRef
elements.description: The mapped BswModuleEntity

elements.name: swcRunnableRef
elements.description: The mapped SWC runnable.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwcBswSynchronizedModeGroupPrototype.name: SwcBswSynchronizedModeGroupPrototype
SwcBswSynchronizedModeGroupPrototype.description: Synchronizes a mode group provided by a component via a port with a mode group provided by a BSW module or cluster.

elements.name: bswModeGroupRef
elements.description: The BSW mode group prototype.

elements.name: swcModeGroupIref
elements.description: The SWC mode group prototype provided by a particular port.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwcBswSynchronizedTrigger.name: SwcBswSynchronizedTrigger
SwcBswSynchronizedTrigger.description: Synchronizes a Trigger provided by a component via a port with a Trigger provided by a BSW module or cluster.

elements.name: bswTriggerRef
elements.description: The BSW Trigger.

elements.name: swcTriggerIref
elements.description: The SWC Trigger provided by a particular port.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwcImplementation.name: SwcImplementation
SwcImplementation.description: This meta-class represents a specialization of the general Implementation meta-class with respect to the usage in application software.

elements.name: behaviorRef
elements.description: The internal behavior implemented by this Implementation.

elements.name: perInstanceMemorySizes
elements.description:
Allows a definition of the size of the per-instance memory for this implementation.
The aggregation of PerInstanceMemorySize  is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects, in this case PerInstanceMemory.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: requiredRteVendor
elements.description: Identify a specific RTE vendor. This information is potentially important at the time of integrating (in particular: linking) the application code with the RTE. The semantics is that (if the association exists) the corresponding code has been created to fit to the vendor-mode RTE provided by this specific vendor. Attempting to integrate the code with another RTE generated in vendor mode is in general not possible.

SwcInternalBehavior.name: SwcInternalBehavior
SwcInternalBehavior.description: The SwcInternalBehavior of an AtomicSwComponentType describes the relevant aspects of the software-component with respect to the RTE, i.e. the RunnableEntities and the RTEEvents they respond to.

elements.name: arTypedPerInstanceMemorys
elements.description:
Defines an AUTOSAR typed memory-block that needs to be available for each instance of the SW-component. This is typically only useful if supportsMultipleInstantiation is set to "true" or if the component defines NVRAM access via permanent blocks.
The aggregation of arTypedPerInstanceMemory is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: events
elements.description:
This is a RTEEvent specified for the particular SwcInternalBehavior.

The aggregation of RTEEvent is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of RTE events. Note: the number of RTE events might vary due to the conditional existence of PortPrototypes using DataReceivedEvents or due to different scheduling needs of algorithms.

The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: explicitInterRunnableVariables
elements.description:
Implement state message semantics for establishing communication among runnables of the same component.
The aggregation of explicitInterRunnableVariable is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: handleTerminationAndRestart
elements.description: This attribute controls the behavior with respect to stopping and restarting. The corresponding AtomicSwComponentType may either not support stop and restart, or support only stop, or support both stop and restart.

elements.name: implicitInterRunnableVariables
elements.description:
Implement state message semantics for establishing communication among runnables of the same component.
The aggregation of implicitInterRunnableVariable is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: includedDataTypeSets
elements.description: The includedDataTypeSet is used by a software component for its implementation.

elements.name: includedModeDeclarationGroupSets
elements.description: This aggregation represents the included ModeDeclarationGroups

elements.name: instantiationDataDefPropss
elements.description:
The purpose of this is that within the context  of a given SwComponentType some data def properties of individual instantiations can be  modified. 
The aggregation of InstantiationDataDefProps is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of PortPrototypes and component local memories like "perInstanceParameter" or "arTypedPerInstanceMemory".


The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: perInstanceMemorys
elements.description:
Defines a per-instance memory object needed by this software component.
The aggregation of PerInstanceMemory is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: perInstanceParameters
elements.description:
Defines parameter(s) or characteristic value(s) that needs to be available for each instance of the software-component. This is typically only useful if supportsMultipleInstantiation is set to "true".
The aggregation of perInstanceParameter is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: portApiOptions
elements.description:
Options for generating the signature of port-related calls from a runnable to the RTE and vice versa.
The aggregation of PortPrototypes is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of ports. 
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: runnables
elements.description:
This is a RunnableEntity specified for the particular SwcInternalBehavior.

The aggregation of RunnableEntity is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of RunnableEntities. Note: the number of RunnableEntities might vary due to the conditional existence of PortPrototypes using DataReceivedEvents or due to different scheduling needs of algorithms.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: serviceDependencys
elements.description:
Defines the requirements on AUTOSAR Services for a particular item.

The aggregation of SwcServiceDependency is subject to variability with the purpose to support the conditional existence of ports as well as the conditional existence of ServiceNeeds.

The SwcServiceDependency owned by an SwcInternalBehavior can be located in a different physical file in order to support that SwcServiceDependency might be provided in later development 
steps or even by different expert domain (e.g OBD expert for Obd related  Service Needs) tools. Therefore the aggregation is <<atpSplitable>>.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: sharedParameters
elements.description:
Defines parameter(s) or characteristic value(s) shared between SwComponentPrototypes of the same SwComponentType
The aggregation of sharedParameter is subject to variability with the purpose to support variability in the software components implementations. Typically different algorithms in the implementation are requiring different number of memory objects.
The upper multiplicity of this role has been increased to * due to resolving an atpVariation stereotype. The previous value was -1.

elements.name: supportsMultipleInstantiation
elements.description: Indicate whether the corresponding software-component can be multiply instantiated on one ECU. In this case the attribute will result in an appropriate component API on programming language level (with or without instance handle).

elements.name: variationPointProxys
elements.description: Proxy of a variation points in the C/C++ implementation.

elements.name: variationPoint
elements.description: This element was generated/modified due to an atpVariation stereotype.

SwcModeManagerErrorEvent.name: SwcModeManagerErrorEvent
SwcModeManagerErrorEvent.description: This represents the ability to react on errors occurring during mode handling.
